package io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant;

import jakarta.enterprise.context.ApplicationScoped;
import jakarta.ws.rs.WebApplicationException;

/**
 * The single check used by every REST route that only a session's own MCP server may call. The token keeps
 * sessions apart and stops casual local callers. It does not protect Axiom from the agent itself, which can
 * read its own token from its environment.
 */
@ApplicationScoped
public class SessionTokenGuard {

    /** Request header carrying the session's MCP token. */
    public static final String HEADER = "X-Axiom-Session-Token";

    /**
     * Requires the presented token to match the session's token.
     *
     * @param session the live session the route belongs to, or null if none is running
     * @param presented the header value, possibly null
     * @throws WebApplicationException with status 401 if the session is missing or the token does not match
     */
    public void require(AssistantSession session, String presented) {
        if (session == null || !session.verifyMcpToken(presented)) {
            throw new WebApplicationException("Missing or invalid " + HEADER, 401);
        }
    }
}

In AssistantResourceImpl.validateAssistantItem, replace the inline token check with tokenGuard.require(session, httpHeaders.getHeaderString(SessionTokenGuard.HEADER));, injecting SessionTokenGuard tokenGuard. Remove the now-unused SESSION_TOKEN_HEADER constant, or point it at SessionTokenGuard.HEADER if tests reference it (check with git grep SESSION_TOKEN_HEADER).

  • [ ] Step 4: Make the journal asynchronous

Rewrite HistoryJournal, keeping FILE_NAME, the constructor signature and load: - Fields: a LinkedBlockingQueue<Object> queue, a daemon Thread named history-journal-<file name> that is started in the constructor, a volatile boolean closed, and a private static final Object STOP. - accept(event): if not closed, build the JSON line ({"type":...,"data":...}) on the calling thread and offer the string. Never block, never throw. - Writer loop: take() items. On a String, append it with Files.writeString(file, line + "\n", UTF_8, CREATE, APPEND) and log I/O errors at WARN. On a CountDownLatch, count it down (this is the flush marker). On STOP, exit. - flush(): enqueue a CountDownLatch(1) and await it for up to 10 seconds. Return quietly if the journal is closed. - close(): if not already closed, set closed, enqueue STOP, and join the thread for up to 10 seconds. - load: where it builds new SseEvent(type, line.path("data")), use line.path("data").isObject() ? line.path("data") : mapper.createObjectNode().

Javadoc must state that ordering is preserved and that disk I/O never runs on the caller's thread. Writes used to happen while AssistantSession's event lock was held; now they don't.

AssistantSessionManager.createSession creates the journal inline. Keep a reference to it: add a field private final Map<String, HistoryJournal> journals = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();, put the journal there by session id, and in destroySession call journals.remove(sessionId) then close() before deleting the session directory.

    void configuresWorkbenchServerWithCompositionAndToken() throws IOException {
        AssistantSession session = create(List.of());
        assertTrue(session.hasCapability(SessionCapability.COMPOSITION));
        JsonNode config = mapper.readTree(Files.readString(session.getSessionDirectory().resolve("mcp-config.json")));
        JsonNode env = config.path("mcpServers").path("workbench").path("env");
        assertEquals("42", env.path("AXIOM_COMPOSITION_ID").asText());

    @Test
    void seededHistoryIsVisibleAndJournaledOnce() throws IOException {
        ObjectNode data = mapper.createObjectNode().put("content", "earlier question");
        AssistantSession session = create(List.of(new SseEvent("user_message", data)));
        assertEquals("earlier question", session.getEventHistory().get(0).data().path("content").asText());
        manager.journal(session.getId()).flush();
        List<SseEvent> journaled = HistoryJournal.load(
                session.getSessionDirectory().resolve(HistoryJournal.FILE_NAME), mapper);
        assertEquals(1, journaled.stream().filter(e -> "earlier question".equals(e.data().path("content").asText())).count());
    }

    @Test
    void destroyCanKeepDirectory() throws IOException {
        AssistantSession session = create(List.of());
        Path dir = session.getSessionDirectory();
        manager.destroySession(session.getId(), true);
        created.remove(session.getId());
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(dir));
        manager.destroySession(session.getId(), false);
    }
}

The last line runs after the session has already been removed, so it is a no-op. Delete the kept directory in the test with the same recursive helper the context builder uses (contextBuilder.deleteSessionDirectory(dir), injected as AssistantContextBuilder), so the test leaves nothing behind.

Interfaces: - Consumes: AssistantSessionManager.createSession(name, templateId, subjectId, compositionId, seed), getSession, destroySession(id, keepDirectory), sessionDirectory(id) and HistoryJournal.load (Tasks 1 and 2). - Produces: - record WorkbenchSessionEvent(long compositionId, Kind kind, String detail), with enum Kind { TURN_COMPLETE, FAILED }. It is fired as a CDI event when the composition's session emits turn_complete (TURN_COMPLETE), session_ended, or a session_error whose name is not ProviderRetry (FAILED, with detail = the message). - WorkbenchSessions (@ApplicationScoped): - AssistantSession live(long compositionId): the running session, or null. - AssistantSession ensure(long compositionId): returns the live session, or starts one from axiom-workbench and stores its id in CompositionEntity.assistantSessionId (in its own transaction). If the composition previously had a session whose directory still exists, that directory's history.jsonl is loaded and seeded, the old directory is deleted, and a recap is armed. - String takeRecap(long compositionId): the armed recap text, or null. Taking it disarms it. - void send(long compositionId, String text) throws IOException: ensure(...), then session.sendMessage(text). - void notice(long compositionId, String text): adds an assistant_text event with notice: true to the live session, if any. It does not reach the agent. - void interrupt(long compositionId) - void discard(long compositionId): destroys the live session and deletes any kept directory.

/**
 * Binding compositions to workbench sessions, restoring history and translating session events.

@QuarkusTest
class WorkbenchSessionsTest {

    /** Collects events fired during the test. */
    @Singleton
    static class Recorder {
        final List<WorkbenchSessionEvent> events = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

        void on(@Observes WorkbenchSessionEvent event) {
            events.add(event);
        }
    }

    @InjectMock
    InteractiveSessionDriverFactory driverFactory;

    @Inject
    WorkbenchSessions sessions;

    @Inject
    CompositionService compositions;

    @Inject
    AssistantSessionManager manager;

    @Inject
    Recorder recorder;

    @Inject
    ObjectMapper mapper;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanUp() {
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().call(() -> CompositionEntity.<CompositionEntity>listAll()).forEach(c -> sessions.discard(c.id));
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() -> {
            CompositionRevisionEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionItemEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionEntity.deleteAll();
        });
        recorder.events.clear();
    }

    private void mockDriver() {
        when(driverFactory.createDriver(any())).thenAnswer(i -> {
            InteractiveSessionDriver driver = mock(InteractiveSessionDriver.class);
            when(driver.getStatus()).thenReturn(AssistantSession.Status.RUNNING);
            return driver;
        });
    }

    @Test
    void ensureBindsOneSessionPerComposition() {
        mockDriver();
        CompositionEntity composition = compositions.create("c", "goal", null, null, null);
        AssistantSession first = sessions.ensure(composition.id);
        assertSame(first, sessions.ensure(composition.id));
        assertEquals(first.getId(), compositions.get(composition.id).assistantSessionId);
        assertNull(sessions.takeRecap(composition.id));
    }

    @Test
    void turnCompleteAndErrorsAreTranslated() {
        mockDriver();
        CompositionEntity composition = compositions.create("c", null, null, null, null);
        AssistantSession session = sessions.ensure(composition.id);
        session.addEvent(new io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant.AssistantEventParser.SseEvent("turn_complete", mapper.createObjectNode()));
        session.addEvent(new io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant.AssistantEventParser.SseEvent("session_error",
                mapper.createObjectNode().put("name", "ProviderRetry").put("message", "retrying")));
        session.addEvent(new io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant.AssistantEventParser.SseEvent("session_error",
                mapper.createObjectNode().put("name", "Boom").put("message", "broken")));
        assertEquals(List.of(WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.TURN_COMPLETE, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.FAILED),
                recorder.events.stream().map(WorkbenchSessionEvent::kind).toList());
        assertEquals("broken", recorder.events.get(1).detail());
    }

    @Test
    void restartRestoresHistoryAndArmsRecap() throws IOException {
        mockDriver();
        CompositionEntity composition = compositions.create("c", "triage issues", null, null, null);
        AssistantSession first = sessions.ensure(composition.id);
        first.sendMessage("build me a triage workflow");
        manager.journal(first.getId()).flush();
        // Simulate a server restart: the process goes away but the directory is kept.
        manager.destroySession(first.getId(), true);
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(AssistantSessionManager.sessionDirectory(first.getId())));

        AssistantSession second = sessions.ensure(composition.id);
        assertNotEquals(first.getId(), second.getId());
        assertTrue(second.getEventHistory().stream()
                .anyMatch(e -> "build me a triage workflow".equals(e.data().path("content").asText())));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(AssistantSessionManager.sessionDirectory(first.getId())));
        String recap = sessions.takeRecap(composition.id);
        assertNotNull(recap);
        assertTrue(recap.contains("triage issues"), recap);
        assertTrue(recap.contains("build me a triage workflow"), recap);
        assertNull(sessions.takeRecap(composition.id));

    @Test
    void noticeIsVisibleButNotSentToAgent() {
        mockDriver();
        CompositionEntity composition = compositions.create("c", null, null, null, null);
        AssistantSession session = sessions.ensure(composition.id);
        sessions.notice(composition.id, "The workflow changed while I worked.");
        assertTrue(session.getEventHistory().stream().anyMatch(e -> e.data().path("notice").asBoolean()));
    }
}

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.composition;

/**
 * Something happened in a composition's agent session that ends the current turn.
 *
 * @param compositionId the composition
 * @param kind what happened
 * @param detail the error message for {@link Kind#FAILED}, otherwise null
 */
public record WorkbenchSessionEvent(long compositionId, Kind kind, String detail) {

    /** Event kinds. */
    public enum Kind {
        /** The agent finished its turn normally. */
        TURN_COMPLETE,
        /** The agent's turn ended because of an error, or the session ended. */
        FAILED
    }
}

WorkbenchSessions implementation requirements: - Injection: AssistantSessionManager manager, CompositionService compositions, Event<WorkbenchSessionEvent> events and ObjectMapper mapper. Keep ConcurrentHashMap<Long, String> recaps. - ensure is synchronized, so a composition never gets two sessions. In order: 1. Read the composition with compositions.get(id). 2. If assistantSessionId points at a live session (manager.getSession(...) != null), return it. 3. If a previous id exists and its directory exists, load history.jsonl from it into seed. 4. Call manager.createSession(composition.name, "axiom-workbench", null, id, seed). 5. Attach the listener described below. 6. Store the new session id with QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(...), setting assistantSessionId and updatedOn. 7. Delete the old directory with AssistantContextBuilder.deleteSessionDirectory. 8. If seed was not empty, put the recap. 9. Wrap IOException in IllegalStateException("Could not start the workbench agent: " + message). - Recap text:

This conversation is being resumed after Axiom restarted. Your previous process ended, so here is a recap.
Goal: <goal or "(none given)">
Recent conversation (oldest first):
- user: <content>
- assistant: <text>
...
Call get_composition before making changes.

Use the last 20 user_message (data.content) and assistant_text (data.text) events, skipping notices. Truncate each entry to 500 characters with "…". - Listener, attached once per session: - turn_complete fires TURN_COMPLETE. - session_ended fires FAILED with data.message, or "The agent session ended". - session_error whose name is not ProviderRetry fires FAILED with data.message. - Fire with events.fire(...) inside a try/catch that logs at WARN. Never throw from the listener. - notice: session.addEvent(new SseEvent("assistant_text", mapper.createObjectNode().put("text", text).put("notice", true))). - discard(id): if the composition still exists and has an assistantSessionId, call manager.destroySession(sessionId, false), then delete any directory left at sessionDirectory(sessionId). This method must work when the composition row is gone, so look it up with CompositionEntity.findById and treat null as "nothing to do". - CompositionService.delete(id): call workbenchSessions.discard(id) before deleting rows. Injecting WorkbenchSessions into CompositionService creates a cycle (WorkbenchSessions injects CompositionService). Break it by injecting jakarta.enterprise.inject.Instance<WorkbenchSessions> and calling .get() lazily.

Interfaces: - Produces: - WorkflowDiffs.summarize(JsonNode before, JsonNode after): String. This is pure. It returns lines of the form added nodes: a, b, removed nodes: c, changed nodes: d (any node JSON other than position differs), and edges changed (if the edge arrays differ as sets). It returns an empty string when nothing differs. Node position is ignored. - TurnPreamble (@ApplicationScoped): String build(long compositionId, List<String> selectedNodeIds, List<String> selectedEdgeIds). It returns the text that is put before the user's message. In order: 1. [Workbench context] 2. Workflow content revision: <rev>, or No workflow yet. 3. The user-edit summary since lastTurnStartedOn. For every item with a user revision created after that instant: - <type> '<name>': edited by the user, and for the workflow, the indented WorkflowDiffs.summarize(<content at the latest revision created at or before lastTurnStartedOn>, <current content>). If lastTurnStartedOn is null, the summary is skipped. If there is nothing to report, it prints User edits since your last turn: none. 4. The user is looking at: nodes [..] edges [..] when the selection is not empty. 5. [End of workbench context]

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.composition;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Unit tests for the node-level workflow summary used in turn preambles.
 */
class WorkflowDiffsTest {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private static JsonNode json(String text) throws Exception {
        return MAPPER.readTree(text);
    }

    @Test
    void reportsAddedRemovedChangedAndEdges() throws Exception {
        JsonNode before = json("""
                {"nodes":[{"id":"a","name":"A"},{"id":"b","name":"B"},{"id":"c","name":"C","position":{"x":1,"y":1}}],
                 "edges":[{"id":"e1","source":"a","target":"b"}]}""");
        JsonNode after = json("""
                {"nodes":[{"id":"a","name":"A2"},{"id":"c","name":"C","position":{"x":9,"y":9}},{"id":"d","name":"D"}],
                 "edges":[{"id":"e2","source":"a","target":"d"}]}""");
        String summary = WorkflowDiffs.summarize(before, after);
        assertTrue(summary.contains("added nodes: d"), summary);
        assertTrue(summary.contains("removed nodes: b"), summary);
        assertTrue(summary.contains("changed nodes: a"), summary);
        assertTrue(summary.contains("edges changed"), summary);
    }

    @Test
    void layoutOnlyIsNoChange() throws Exception {
        JsonNode before = json("{\"nodes\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"position\":{\"x\":1,\"y\":1}}],\"edges\":[]}");
        JsonNode after = json("{\"nodes\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"position\":{\"x\":5,\"y\":1}}],\"edges\":[]}");
        assertEquals("", WorkflowDiffs.summarize(before, after));
    }
}

        CompositionItemEntity tool = service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.TOOL, "tp-tool");
        Thread.sleep(5);
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() -> {
            CompositionEntity c = CompositionEntity.findById(composition.id);
            c.lastTurnStartedOn = Instant.now();
        });
        Thread.sleep(5);
        ObjectNode content = (ObjectNode) service.contentOf(workflow);
        ((ObjectNode) content.path("nodes").get(0)).put("name", "Begin");
        service.save(composition.id, workflow.id, content, workflow.contentRevision, CompositionService.AUTHOR_USER, null);

        String text = preamble.build(composition.id, List.of("start-1"), List.of());
        assertTrue(text.startsWith("[Workbench context]"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("Workflow content revision: sha256:"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("workflow 'tp-wf': edited by the user"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("changed nodes: start-1"), text);
        assertTrue(!text.contains("tp-tool"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("The user is looking at: nodes [start-1]"), text);
    }

    @Test
    void firstTurnHasNoEditSummary() {
        CompositionEntity composition = service.create("c", null, null, null, null);
        String text = preamble.build(composition.id, List.of(), List.of());
        assertTrue(text.contains("No workflow yet."), text);
        assertTrue(!text.contains("User edits since your last turn"), text);
    }
}

  • WorkflowDiffs (final class, private constructor):

  • Index nodes by id into a LinkedHashMap<String, JsonNode>, with position removed from a deep copy.
  • added = ids only in after, removed = ids only in before, changed = ids in both whose stripped JSON differs.
  • Edges differ if new HashSet<>(beforeEdges) does not equal new HashSet<>(afterEdges), comparing each edge's toString().
  • Join the non-empty parts with \n in the order added, removed, changed, edges changed.
  • TurnPreamble:
  • Inject CompositionService service.
  • Find the workflow item with service.items(id) (type workflow).
  • For the edit summary, query CompositionRevisionEntity.list("itemId = ?1 and author = 'user' and createdOn > ?2", item.id, since) for each item.
  • For the workflow base, use CompositionRevisionEntity.find("itemId = ?1 and createdOn <= ?2 order by createdOn desc, id desc", item.id, since).firstResult(). If none exists, skip the diff lines.

  • Lines are joined with \n. Javadoc must explain that this context is sent to the agent ahead of the user's message on every turn.

docs.text:
Files: - Create: app/src/main/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/composition/CompositionTurns.java - Test: app/src/test/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/composition/CompositionTurnsTest.java

Interfaces: - Consumes: - WorkbenchSessions.send/notice/interrupt/takeRecap and WorkbenchSessionEvent (Task 4) - TurnPreamble.build (Task 5) - CompositionService and CompositionValidator (2a) - Flow's ChangeSets.applyChecked and ContentRevision.of - SseEvent.compositionTurn / compositionChangeSet (Task 3) - Produces CompositionTurns (@ApplicationScoped, with synchronized public methods): - String start(long compositionId, String message, List<String> nodeIds, List<String> edgeIds). Returns the new turnId (a UUID). Throws CompositionConflictException if a turn is already running, and IllegalArgumentException for a blank message. - record ChangeSetOutcome(boolean applied, String contentRevision, List<ConfigProblem> problems, ChangeSetError error) - ChangeSetOutcome applyChangeSet(long compositionId, JsonNode changeSet) - record AgentWrite(CompositionItemEntity item, List<ConfigProblem> problems) - AgentWrite upsert(long compositionId, String type, JsonNode content) - void remove(long compositionId, String type, String name) - JsonNode currentWorkflow(long compositionId): the turn's working workflow while a turn runs, otherwise the saved workflow content. Null if there is no workflow. - String currentTurnId(long compositionId): the running turn id, or null. - void resolve(long compositionId, String turnId, String outcome), where outcome is one of applied, accepted, rejected, stale. - void interrupt(long compositionId) - void onSessionEvent(@Observes WorkbenchSessionEvent event), which finishes the turn. - void onStartup(@Observes StartupEvent event), which resets ai-working compositions to idle. - Constants: AUTHOR = "agent:axiom-workbench", plus STALE_RETRY_PROMPT, FAILED_NOTICE_PREFIX and SECOND_STALE_NOTICE (texts below).

Behaviour: - start: 1. Lock the composition row with CompositionEntity.findById(id, PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) in a transaction. 2. Build the preamble with the previous lastTurnStartedOn. 3. Set turnState = ai-working, currentTurnId, lastTurnStartedOn = now and updatedOn. 4. Record an in-memory Turn(turnId, workflowItemId or null, baseRevision, baseContent, working, ops = [], staleRetry flag), where baseContent and working are the saved workflow content. 5. After commit, fire compositionTurn(..., "ai-working"). 6. Send (recap == null ? "" : recap + "\n\n") + preamble + "\n\n" + message. 7. If sending throws, finish the turn as failed (back to idle, with a notice) and throw IllegalStateException. - applyChangeSet: - Require a running turn (CompositionConflictException("No AI turn is running")) and a workflow item (IllegalArgumentException("The composition has no workflow yet; create one with upsert_item type workflow")). - If changeSet.baseRevision is not the working revision, return applied = false with error stale: "Base revision is not the current working revision ; call get_composition". - Otherwise call ChangeSets.applyChecked(working, changeSet). A Rejected result returns applied = false with the error. - On Applied, set working to the result, append every element of changeSet.ops to the turn's ops, and return applied = true with the new revision and validator.validateContent(id, WORKFLOW, item.name, working). - Nothing is persisted. - upsert: - Require a running turn. - type is action-type or tool, or workflow only when the composition has no workflow yet. - The name is CompositionItems.nameOf(content), which is required. For a workflow, it also becomes the item name. - If the item exists, call service.save(id, itemId, content, null, AUTHOR_AI, turnId). Otherwise call addBlank then save with the same arguments. - Return the problems from validator.validateContent. - A workflow created this way also becomes the turn's baseContent and working (so later change sets apply to it), with baseRevision = its revision. - remove: require a running turn. Only action-type and tool can be removed (workflows cannot). Unknown items give CompositionNotFoundException. - Finishing (from onSessionEvent, for this composition only): - Remove the in-memory turn. - In a transaction with a locked row: set turnState = idle and currentTurnId = null. - On TURN_COMPLETE with non-empty ops, build the combined change set {"id": turnId, "baseRevision": baseRevision, "author": AUTHOR, "summary": "AI turn: <n> workflow change(s)", "ops": [...]}, then set pendingChangeSet (as a string) and pendingTurnId. A newer pending change set replaces an older one. - After commit, fire compositionChangeSet (if one was created), then compositionTurn(..., "idle"). - On FAILED, discard the ops and post the notice FAILED_NOTICE_PREFIX + detail + " Workflow changes from this turn were discarded; action type and tool changes were kept (use Undo AI turn to revert them)." - An event for a composition with no running turn only makes sure the state is idle. - resolve: - If pendingTurnId does not equal turnId, do nothing. - Otherwise clear pendingChangeSet and pendingTurnId. - If the outcome is stale: - If the stale turn was itself a stale retry, or a turn is now running, post SECOND_STALE_NOTICE. - Otherwise call start(id, STALE_RETRY_PROMPT, [], []) and mark the new turn as a stale retry. - interrupt: sessions.interrupt(id). The turn ends when the session reports it. - Startup: for every composition in ai-working, set idle and currentTurnId = null. The in-memory turns were lost with the restart, so their workflow ops are dropped. - Texts: - STALE_RETRY_PROMPT: "Your workflow changes from the last turn could not be applied because the user changed the workflow while you were working. Call get_composition to see the current workflow, then resubmit the workflow changes that still make sense." - SECOND_STALE_NOTICE: "The workflow changed again before my changes could be applied, so I stopped. Ask me to try again when you are ready." - FAILED_NOTICE_PREFIX: "The AI turn ended with an error: "

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.composition;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import io.apitomy.axiom.app.validation.ConfigItemType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionEntity;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionItemEntity;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionRevisionEntity;
import io.apitomy.flow.changeset.ContentRevision;
import io.quarkus.narayana.jta.QuarkusTransaction;
import io.quarkus.test.InjectMock;
import io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTest;
import jakarta.inject.Inject;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;

import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.atLeastOnce;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.times;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

/**
 * The AI turn lifecycle: starting, accumulating change sets, agent writes, finishing and stale retries.
 */
@QuarkusTest
class CompositionTurnsTest {

    @InjectMock
    WorkbenchSessions sessions;

    @Inject
    CompositionTurns turns;

    @Inject
    CompositionService service;

    @Inject
    ObjectMapper mapper;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanUp() {
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().call(() -> CompositionEntity.<CompositionEntity>listAll())
                .forEach(c -> turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(c.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.FAILED, "cleanup")));
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() -> {
            CompositionRevisionEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionItemEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionEntity.deleteAll();
        });
    }

    private CompositionEntity withWorkflow() {
        CompositionEntity composition = service.create("c", "goal", null, null, null);
        service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.WORKFLOW, "ct-wf");
        return composition;
    }

    private JsonNode renameStart(String baseRevision, String name) throws Exception {
        return mapper.readTree("""
                {"id":"cs-%s","baseRevision":"%s","author":"agent:axiom-workbench","summary":"rename",
                 "ops":[{"op":"updateNode","id":"start-1","patch":{"name":"%s"}}]}""".formatted(name, baseRevision, name));
    }

    private CompositionEntity reload(long id) {
        return QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().call(() -> CompositionEntity.<CompositionEntity>findById(id));
    }

    @Test
    void startSendsPreambleAndMarksWorking() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String turnId = turns.start(composition.id, "Add a triage step", List.of("start-1"), List.of());
        ArgumentCaptor<String> text = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        verify(sessions).send(eq(composition.id), text.capture());
        assertTrue(text.getValue().contains("[Workbench context]"), text.getValue());
        assertTrue(text.getValue().endsWith("Add a triage step"), text.getValue());
        CompositionEntity saved = reload(composition.id);
        assertEquals(CompositionEntity.TURN_AI_WORKING, saved.turnState);
        assertEquals(turnId, saved.currentTurnId);
        assertNotNull(saved.lastTurnStartedOn);
        assertThrows(CompositionConflictException.class, () -> turns.start(composition.id, "again", List.of(), List.of()));
    }

    @Test
    void changeSetsAccumulateAgainstTheWorkingRevision() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String base = ContentRevision.of(turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id));
        String turnId = turns.start(composition.id, "rename", List.of(), List.of());

        CompositionTurns.ChangeSetOutcome first = turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(base, "Begin"));
        assertTrue(first.applied());
        CompositionTurns.ChangeSetOutcome stale = turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(base, "Again"));
        assertFalse(stale.applied());
        assertEquals("stale", stale.error().code());
        CompositionTurns.ChangeSetOutcome second = turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(first.contentRevision(), "Go"));
        assertTrue(second.applied());
        assertEquals("Go", turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id).path("nodes").get(0).path("name").asText());

        turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(composition.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.TURN_COMPLETE, null));
        CompositionEntity saved = reload(composition.id);
        assertEquals(CompositionEntity.TURN_IDLE, saved.turnState);
        assertEquals(turnId, saved.pendingTurnId);
        JsonNode pending = mapper.readTree(saved.pendingChangeSet);
        assertEquals(base, pending.path("baseRevision").asText());
        assertEquals(turnId, pending.path("id").asText());
        assertEquals("agent:axiom-workbench", pending.path("author").asText());
        assertEquals(2, pending.path("ops").size());
        // Only the editor commits workflow change sets: the saved draft is unchanged by the turn.
        assertEquals("Start", service.contentOf(service.items(composition.id).get(0))
                .path("nodes").get(0).path("name").asText());
    }

    @Test
    void agentUpsertIsTaggedWithTheTurn() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String turnId = turns.start(composition.id, "make a tool", List.of(), List.of());
        ObjectNode tool = CompositionItems.blank(ConfigItemType.TOOL, "ct-tool", mapper);
        CompositionTurns.AgentWrite write = turns.upsert(composition.id, "tool", tool);
        assertEquals("ai", write.item().lastAuthor);
        assertEquals(turnId, write.item().lastTurnId);
        tool.put("description", "v2");
        assertEquals(turnId, turns.upsert(composition.id, "tool", tool).item().lastTurnId);
        assertEquals(1, service.items(composition.id).stream().filter(i -> "tool".equals(i.itemType)).count());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> turns.upsert(composition.id, "workflow", CompositionItems.blank(ConfigItemType.WORKFLOW, "x", mapper)));
    }

    @Test
    void agentWritesRequireARunningTurn() {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        assertThrows(CompositionConflictException.class, () -> turns.upsert(composition.id, "tool",
                CompositionItems.blank(ConfigItemType.TOOL, "t", mapper)));
    }

    @Test
    void failedTurnDiscardsWorkflowOpsAndNotifies() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String base = ContentRevision.of(turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id));
        turns.start(composition.id, "rename", List.of(), List.of());
        turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(base, "Begin"));
        turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(composition.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.FAILED, "boom"));
        CompositionEntity saved = reload(composition.id);
        assertEquals(CompositionEntity.TURN_IDLE, saved.turnState);
        assertNull(saved.pendingChangeSet);
        verify(sessions).notice(eq(composition.id), org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.startsWith(CompositionTurns.FAILED_NOTICE_PREFIX + "boom"));
    }

    @Test
    void staleResolutionRetriesOnceThenStops() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String base = ContentRevision.of(turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id));
        String turnId = turns.start(composition.id, "rename", List.of(), List.of());
        turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(base, "Begin"));
        turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(composition.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.TURN_COMPLETE, null));

        turns.resolve(composition.id, turnId, "stale");
        assertNull(reload(composition.id).pendingChangeSet);
        verify(sessions).send(eq(composition.id), org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.endsWith(CompositionTurns.STALE_RETRY_PROMPT));
        String retryTurn = reload(composition.id).currentTurnId;
        String retryBase = ContentRevision.of(turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id));
        turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(retryBase, "Again"));
        turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(composition.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.TURN_COMPLETE, null));

        turns.resolve(composition.id, retryTurn, "stale");
        verify(sessions).notice(composition.id, CompositionTurns.SECOND_STALE_NOTICE);
        verify(sessions, times(2)).send(anyLong(), anyString());
    }

    @Test
    void acceptedResolutionClearsPendingAndIgnoresOtherTurns() throws Exception {
        CompositionEntity composition = withWorkflow();
        String base = ContentRevision.of(turns.currentWorkflow(composition.id));
        String turnId = turns.start(composition.id, "rename", List.of(), List.of());
        turns.applyChangeSet(composition.id, renameStart(base, "Begin"));
        turns.onSessionEvent(new WorkbenchSessionEvent(composition.id, WorkbenchSessionEvent.Kind.TURN_COMPLETE, null));
        turns.resolve(composition.id, "other-turn", "applied");
        assertNotNull(reload(composition.id).pendingChangeSet);
        turns.resolve(composition.id, turnId, "applied");
        assertNull(reload(composition.id).pendingChangeSet);
        verify(sessions, never()).notice(eq(composition.id), anyString());
        verify(sessions, atLeastOnce()).send(anyLong(), anyString());
    }
}

  • [ ] Step 3: Implement CompositionTurns, following the Behaviour section above.

Implementation notes: - Keep ConcurrentHashMap<Long, Turn> turns and a Set<String> staleRetryTurnIds. Turn is a private static final class with mutable working and ops (an ArrayNode). - Use QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run/call for each database step. That way the SSE events can be fired right after call returns (the transaction is committed by then), and the agent is never called while a transaction is open. - The Flow result is a sealed type: switch over ChangeSetResult with instanceof ChangeSetResult.Applied applied and ChangeSetResult.Rejected rejected. - ChangeSetError for the stale case is new ChangeSetError("stale", null, "..."). - Inject Event<io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.SseEvent> sseEvents. - Javadoc each public method, stating which fields it locks and which events it fires.

docs.title: Task 7: Undo an AI turn (TurnUndo)
docs.text:
Files: - Create: app/src/main/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/composition/TurnUndo.java - Modify: CompositionService.java (the addBlank overload) and CompositionTurns.java (upsert uses it) - Test: app/src/test/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/composition/TurnUndoTest.java

Interfaces: - Produces: - record TurnUndo.Result(List<String> restored, List<String> removed, List<String> skipped, JsonNode workflowBefore, boolean workflowRestorable). The list entries are "<type>/<name>". - TurnUndo.undo(long compositionId, String turnId): Result. It throws CompositionConflictException while a turn is running, and CompositionNotFoundException if no revision carries turnId.

Behaviour, for each composition item with at least one revision whose turnId equals turnId: - Let first be the earliest of those revisions, and before the latest revision ordered strictly before first by (createdOn, id). - If the item's latest revision is not one of the turn's revisions (the user or a later turn changed it), add the item to skipped. - Workflow items: never change them on the server. Set workflowBefore to the before content (null if there is none) and workflowRestorable to true unless the item was skipped. The client applies the undo with handle.replace(workflowBefore, 'host'), as the spec describes. - Other items: if before exists, call service.save(id, itemId, before.content, null, AUTHOR_USER, null) and add the item to restored. Otherwise (the turn created the item) call service.removeItem and add it to removed. - All of this runs in one transaction.

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.composition;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import io.apitomy.axiom.app.validation.ConfigItemType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionEntity;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionItemEntity;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.CompositionRevisionEntity;
import io.quarkus.narayana.jta.QuarkusTransaction;
import io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTest;
import jakarta.inject.Inject;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Undoing an AI turn restores, removes or skips the items it touched.
 */
@QuarkusTest
class TurnUndoTest {

    @Inject
    CompositionService service;

    @Inject
    TurnUndo undo;

    @Inject
    ObjectMapper mapper;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanUp() {
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() -> {
            CompositionRevisionEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionItemEntity.deleteAll();
            CompositionEntity.deleteAll();
        });
    }

    private CompositionItemEntity aiSave(long compositionId, CompositionItemEntity item, String description, String turnId) {
        ObjectNode content = (ObjectNode) service.contentOf(item);
        content.put("description", description);
        return service.save(compositionId, item.id, content, null, CompositionService.AUTHOR_AI, turnId);
    }

    @Test
    void restoresChangedRemovesCreatedSkipsLaterEdited() {
        CompositionEntity composition = service.create("c", null, null, null, null);
        CompositionItemEntity workflow = service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.WORKFLOW, "tu-wf");
        CompositionItemEntity changed = service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.TOOL, "tu-changed");
        CompositionItemEntity edited = service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.TOOL, "tu-edited");
        String originalChanged = changed.contentRevision;

        aiSave(composition.id, changed, "by ai", "t1");
        CompositionItemEntity editedAi = aiSave(composition.id, edited, "by ai", "t1");
        service.addBlank(composition.id, ConfigItemType.TOOL, "tu-created", CompositionService.AUTHOR_AI, "t1");
        aiSave(composition.id, workflow, "wf by ai", "t1");
        aiSave(composition.id, editedAi, "by user later", null);

        TurnUndo.Result result = undo.undo(composition.id, "t1");
        assertEquals(List.of("tool/tu-changed"), result.restored());
        assertEquals(List.of("tool/tu-edited"), result.skipped());
        assertEquals(List.of("tool/tu-created"), result.removed());
        assertTrue(result.workflowRestorable());
        assertEquals("", result.workflowBefore().path("description").asText(""));
        CompositionItemEntity restored = service.items(composition.id).stream()
                .filter(i -> "tu-changed".equals(i.name)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(originalChanged, restored.contentRevision);
    }

    @Test
    void unknownTurnIsNotFound() {
        CompositionEntity composition = service.create("c", null, null, null, null);
        assertThrows(CompositionNotFoundException.class, () -> undo.undo(composition.id, "nope"));
    }
}

This test uses a new overload, CompositionService.addBlank(long compositionId, ConfigItemType type, String name, String author, String turnId), which records the creation revision with the given author and turn. The existing three-argument form delegates to it with AUTHOR_USER, null. CompositionTurns.upsert must use the overload when it creates an item, so that "created in the turn" means the item has no revision from before the turn.

Operation Request Response POST /compositions/{compositionId}/messages (sendCompositionMessage) CompositionMessage {message (required), nodeIds?: string[], edgeIds?: string[]} 200 Composition; 409 if a turn is running (CompositionConflictError) POST /compositions/{compositionId}/interrupt (interruptComposition) none 204 POST /compositions/{compositionId}/changeset-resolution (resolveCompositionChangeSet) CompositionChangeSetResolution {turnId, outcome: enum [applied, accepted, rejected, stale]} 204 POST /compositions/{compositionId}/turns/{turnId}/undo (undoCompositionTurn) none 200 CompositionUndoResult {restored, removed, skipped: string[], workflowBefore?: CompositionContent, workflowRestorable: boolean}; 409; 404
  • Agent routes (header X-Axiom-Session-Token required, 401 otherwise; documented in each operation's description and with a 401 response):
Operation Request Response GET /compositions/{compositionId}/agent/composition (getAgentComposition) none AgentComposition {compositionId (int64), turnId?, goal?, workflowName?, workflowRevision?, workflow?: CompositionContent, items: AgentItemSummary[]}. AgentItemSummary {type, name, contentRevision, valid, problems: ConfigProblem[]} GET /compositions/{compositionId}/agent/items/{itemType}/{itemName} (getAgentItem) none CompositionContent; 404 PUT /compositions/{compositionId}/agent/items (upsertAgentItem) AgentItemUpsert {type: enum [workflow, action-type, tool], content: CompositionContent} 200 AgentItemResult {type, name, contentRevision, valid, problems}; 400; 409 DELETE /compositions/{compositionId}/agent/items/{itemType}/{itemName} (removeAgentItem) none 204; 404; 409 POST /compositions/{compositionId}/agent/workflow/changesets (proposeAgentWorkflowChanges) CompositionContent (a Flow change set) 200 AgentChangeSetResult {applied, contentRevision?, problems: ConfigProblem[], error?: {code, opIndex?, reason}}; 400 (no workflow); 409 (no turn)

Interfaces: - Consumes: io.apitomy.flow.engine.ConditionEvaluator (public no-argument constructor, with evaluate(expr, context[, event]) and resolve(expr, context[, event]); failures throw ConditionEvaluationException), WorkflowEventMapper.toEventMap(StreamEventEntity, ObjectMapper) and StreamEventEntity (id UUID). - Produces: - ExpressionService.Scope, an enum whose JSON names are those in the Global Constraints table, with boolean usesContext(), boolean usesEvent(), boolean isBoolean() and static Scope fromName(String). fromName throws IllegalArgumentException listing the valid names. - record ExpressionService.Result(boolean ok, JsonNode value, String error) - ExpressionService.evaluate(String expression, String scope, String eventId, JsonNode context): Result. It returns ok = false with a message for an EL error, a missing required eventId, an unknown or invalid eventId, or a non-object context. It throws IllegalArgumentException only for a blank expression or an unknown scope. - Context scopes that are given an eventId also see context.event = the event map, unless the given context already has event. This mirrors runs started by a subscription and receive-event outputs. - REST: POST /expressions/evaluate (operationId evaluateExpression, tag Expressions). - Request ExpressionEvaluateRequest {expression (required), scope (required, enum of the seven names), eventId?, context?: CompositionContent}. - Response 200 ExpressionEvaluateResult {ok, valueJson? (the value as a JSON string), valueType? (enum null|boolean|number|string|object|array), error?}. - 400 for a blank expression or an unknown scope.

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.expressions;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.StreamEventEntity;
import io.quarkus.narayana.jta.QuarkusTransaction;
import io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTest;
import jakarta.inject.Inject;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * EL evaluation per scope, against literal contexts and stored stream events.
 */
@QuarkusTest
class ExpressionServiceTest {

    @Inject
    ExpressionService expressions;

    @Inject
    ObjectMapper mapper;

    private UUID eventId;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanUp() {
        if (eventId != null) {
            QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() -> StreamEventEntity.deleteById(eventId));
        }
    }

    private String storeEvent() {
        eventId = QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().call(() -> {
            StreamEventEntity event = new StreamEventEntity();
            event.id = UUID.randomUUID();
            event.type = "issue.comment.created";
            event.source = "github";
            event.eventSourceId = "github-com";
            event.ref = "https://github.com/o/r/issues/1";
            event.timestamp = Instant.now();
            event.payload = "{\"comment\":{\"body\":\"Here are the logs\"}}";
            event.persist();
            return event.id;
        });
        return eventId.toString();
    }

    @Test
    void edgeConditionIsBooleanOverContext() throws Exception {
        ExpressionService.Result result = expressions.evaluate("context.needsInfo == true", "edge-condition",
                null, mapper.readTree("{\"needsInfo\":true}"));
        assertTrue(result.ok(), result.error());
        assertTrue(result.value().asBoolean());
    }

    @Test
    void humanTaskTitleResolvesAValue() throws Exception {
        ExpressionService.Result result = expressions.evaluate("'No reply on ' += context.ref", "human-task-title",
                null, mapper.readTree("{\"ref\":\"r-1\"}"));
        assertEquals("No reply on r-1", result.value().asText());
    }

    @Test
    void eventKeySeesOnlyTheEvent() {
        String id = storeEvent();
        ExpressionService.Result result = expressions.evaluate("event.ref", "correlation-event-key", id, null);
        assertEquals("https://github.com/o/r/issues/1", result.value().asText());
        ExpressionService.Result payload = expressions.evaluate("event.payload.comment.body", "receive-event-output", id, null);
        assertEquals("Here are the logs", payload.value().asText());
    }

    @Test
    void contextScopesSeeTheEventAsContextEvent() {
        String id = storeEvent();
        ExpressionService.Result result = expressions.evaluate("context.event.type", "action-input", id, null);
        assertEquals("issue.comment.created", result.value().asText());
    }

    @Test
    void reportsErrorsAsResults() {
        assertFalse(expressions.evaluate("event.ref", "receive-event-match", null, null).ok());
        assertFalse(expressions.evaluate("event.ref", "correlation-event-key", "not-a-uuid", null).ok());
        assertFalse(expressions.evaluate("context.(", "action-input", null, null).ok());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> expressions.evaluate(" ", "action-input", null, null));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> expressions.evaluate("1", "nope", null, null));
    }
}

If StreamEventEntity has other non-null columns, set them in storeEvent (check the entity's nullable = false columns).

docs.title: Task 10: The axiom-workbench MCP server
docs.text:
Files: - Modify: app/src/main/resources/templates/axiom-workbench-mcp/server.js (complete it) - Create: app/src/test/node/workbench-mcp.test.js - Create: app/src/test/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/assistant/WorkbenchMcpServerScriptTest.java

Interfaces: - Consumes: the agent routes (Task 8), GET /stream/events and GET /stream/events/{id} (existing), and POST /expressions/evaluate (Task 9). - Produces the MCP tools below (server name workbench, so the agent sees mcp__workbench__<name>). Every handler returns a string. Errors are thrown as Error(message), and the bootstrap turns them into isError results, as in axiom-assistant-mcp/server.js.

Tool Parameters Calls / behaviour get_composition — GET /compositions/{C}/agent/composition, pretty JSON get_item type, name GET .../agent/items/{type}/{name} upsert_item type, item (object) PUT .../agent/items {type, content: item}. Returns VALID, VALID with warnings or INVALID plus - [SEVERITY] path code: message lines, like axiom_validate_item remove_item type, name DELETE .../agent/items/{type}/{name} propose_workflow_changes changeSet (object) POST .../agent/workflow/changesets. Applied: APPLIED. New revision: <rev> plus the problem lines. Not applied: REJECTED (<code> at op <opIndex>): <reason> validate_composition — GET .../agent/composition, then one status line per item with its problem lines list_stream_events type?, eventSourceId?, ref?, limit? (default 10, maximum 20) GET /stream/events?filterType=&filterEventSourceId=&filterRef=&limit=. One summarizeEvent line per event get_stream_event eventId, path? GET /stream/events/{id}. Build the normalized event {id, type, source, eventSourceId, ref, timestamp, actor, payload}, narrow it with pickPath, and pretty-print it through truncateDeep evaluate_expression expression, scope, eventId?, context? (object) POST /expressions/evaluate. Returns OK (<valueType>): <valueJson> or ERROR: <error> Read-only discovery — Copy axiom_list_action_types, axiom_get_action_type, axiom_list_tools, axiom_get_tool and axiom_list_secrets from the assistant server unchanged, keeping their names
  • Parameter types: the bootstrap in axiom-assistant-mcp/server.js maps parameters to {type: p.type || "string"}. Support type: "object" and "number" the same way, so changeSet, item and context are objects.
  • Pure helpers, exported with module.exports = { summarizeEvent, pickPath, truncateDeep, formatProblems } when the file is required, without starting the server (if (require.main === module) { main(); }):
  • summarizeEvent(e) returns "<id> <type> <eventSourceId> <ref> actor=<actor.login||actor.name||-> at <timestamp> keys=[<top-level payload keys>]".
  • pickPath(obj, path) supports dot segments and [n] indexes, for example payload.issue.labels[0].name. It returns undefined when the path is missing.
  • truncateDeep(value, maxString = 2000, maxArray = 50) copies the value. Strings longer than the limit become their first maxString characters plus "…[truncated N chars]". Arrays longer than the limit keep maxArray items plus a final string "…[N more items]".
  • formatProblems(problems) returns - [SEVERITY] path code: message lines.

  • If AXIOM_COMPOSITION_ID or AXIOM_SESSION_TOKEN is empty, main logs a one-line warning to stderr.

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions;

/**

 */
class WorkbenchMcpServerScriptTest {

    @Test
    void nodeHelperTestsPass() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        Assumptions.assumeTrue(nodeAvailable(), "node is not installed");
        Path test = Path.of("src/test/node/workbench-mcp.test.js").toAbsolutePath();
        Process process = new ProcessBuilder("node", "--test", test.toString()).redirectErrorStream(true).start();
        String output = new String(process.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        process.waitFor(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        assertEquals(0, process.exitValue(), output);
    }

    private static boolean nodeAvailable() {
        try {

        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

Interfaces: - Produces: - AssistantReferenceGenerator.generateChangeSetReference(): String, cached. It contains: - the change set shape; - the op table (copy the op names and fields from Flow's ai-assisted-editing.md "Change sets" table: addNode, updateNode, renameNode, removeNode, addEdge, updateEdge, removeEdge, metadata); - the patch semantics (shallow config merge, nested values replaced whole, unset, null is a value); - the error codes; - one complete example change set. It adds a wait node between Start and End of the blank workflow (start-1, end-1, edge-1) by removing edge-1 and adding the node and two edges. - buildSystemPrompt replaces {{changesetReference}} with it. - The template (complete file): - templateId axiom-workbench and capabilities ["composition"]. - mcpServers ["@axiom-workbench"]. - allowedTools: every mcp__workbench__<tool> from Task 10, plus Bash(jq *). No Read, Write or Edit. - The systemPrompt, covering the following.

Role: you build workflows together with the user in a shared workbench. The user can edit the same drafts between your turns, so always work from get_composition.

Working loop: 1. get_composition. 2. Plan the change. 3. Create or update action types and tools with upsert_item and fix every INVALID. 4. Change the workflow only with propose_workflow_changes, using the latest workflowRevision (or the revision returned by your previous change set) as baseRevision. Fix any rejection or problem. 5. Finish with a short summary of what you changed.

Rules (each asserted by the test): - "Edit workflows only with propose_workflow_changes" - "Use the workflowRevision from get_composition, or the revision returned by your last change set, as baseRevision" - "Before writing an EL expression that reads event data, inspect a real event of that type with get_stream_event and check the expression with evaluate_expression" - "If no events of that type exist, say so and use the documented event schema" - "Prefer node action types for non-AI steps" - "Declare an input for everything an action uses" - "Receive-event nodes must correlate" - "Never describe the output format in an agent prompt" - "Your workflow changes are applied by the user's editor when your turn ends"

Reference: {{reference}} then {{changesetReference}}.

Welcome message: "Tell me what this workflow should do, or select something on the canvas and ask me to change it."

package io.apitomy.axiom.app.assistant;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import io.apitomy.axiom.app.WorkflowTemplates;
import io.apitomy.flow.changeset.ChangeSetResult;
import io.apitomy.flow.changeset.ChangeSets;
import io.apitomy.flow.changeset.ContentRevision;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertInstanceOf;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * The workbench template carries its rules, and the change-set reference example is valid for Flow.
 */
class WorkbenchReferenceTest {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private static JsonNode template() throws Exception {
        try (InputStream is = WorkbenchReferenceTest.class.getResourceAsStream(
                "/templates/assistant-templates/axiom-workbench.json")) {
            return MAPPER.readTree(is);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void promptCarriesEveryRule() throws Exception {
        String prompt = template().path("systemPrompt").asText();
        for (String rule : List.of(
                "Edit workflows only with propose_workflow_changes",
                "as baseRevision",
                "inspect a real event of that type with get_stream_event and check the expression with evaluate_expression",
                "If no events of that type exist, say so and use the documented event schema",
                "Prefer node action types for non-AI steps",
                "Declare an input for everything an action uses",
                "Receive-event nodes must correlate",
                "Never describe the output format in an agent prompt",
                "applied by the user's editor when your turn ends",
                "{{reference}}",
                "{{changesetReference}}")) {
            assertTrue(prompt.contains(rule), "prompt must contain: " + rule);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void templateAllowsOnlyWorkbenchToolsAndJq() throws Exception {
        for (JsonNode tool : template().path("allowedTools")) {
            String name = tool.asText();
            assertTrue(name.startsWith("mcp__workbench__") || name.equals("Bash(jq *)"), name);
        }
        assertFalse(template().path("allowedTools").toString().contains("Write"));
    }

    @Test
    void changeSetExampleAppliesToTheBlankWorkflow() throws Exception {
        String reference = new AssistantReferenceGenerator().generateChangeSetReference();
        Matcher json = Pattern.compile("```json\\n(\\{.*?\\})\\n```", Pattern.DOTALL).matcher(reference);
        assertTrue(json.find(), "reference must contain a json example");
        JsonNode workflow = WorkflowTemplates.emptyWorkflow("wf", MAPPER);
        com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode changeSet = (com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode) MAPPER.readTree(json.group(1));
        changeSet.put("baseRevision", ContentRevision.of(workflow));
        assertInstanceOf(ChangeSetResult.Applied.class, ChangeSets.applyChecked(workflow, changeSet));
        for (String code : List.of("target-missing", "duplicate-id", "edge-endpoint-missing", "malformed", "stale")) {
            assertTrue(reference.contains(code), code);
        }
    }
}

If AssistantReferenceGenerator cannot be constructed with new (for example, because it needs injected beans), make generateChangeSetReference delegate to a static String changeSetReference() and call that static method in the test instead.

docs.title: Workbench Phases 3 and 4: Flow 3.0.1 UI Upgrade and Workbench UI Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Upgrade the UI to @apitomy/flow-ui 3.0.1 and build the Workflow Workbench page. The page has a three-pane layout: - a composition tree with revisions and publish; - tabbed editors for the workflow, action types and tools; - an AI chat.

You and the AI take turns editing the same live drafts. AI workflow changes arrive as Flow change sets that the editor applies (live) or stages (review), and an AI turn can be undone.

Architecture: - Data: a thin API layer (config/compositions.ts) over the Phase 2 REST routes, plus a typed SSE helper. - Pure logic in testable modules (pages/workbench/*.ts): - tree status - publish selection - turn and lock state - undo decision - preferences - Page: WorkbenchPage assembles a resizable three-pane layout from small components. - Workflow tab: the Flow WorkflowEditor, driven through its imperative handle. - Action type and tool tabs: controlled editors extracted from the existing detail pages, which are refactored to use them, so there is one editor implementation. - Chat: the existing AssistantChatPanel, with send and interrupt redirected to the composition routes.

Tech Stack: React 19, TypeScript, PatternFly 6, react-router 7, @apitomy/flow-ui 3.0.1, Vitest with jsdom and Testing Library. The backend is Java/Quarkus, contract-first; this plan adds one endpoint.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-workflow-workbench-design.md, especially §2 (UI), §3 (REST) and §4 (errors). Flow reference: apitomy-flow/docs/user-guide/ai-assisted-editing.md.

docs.title: Global Constraints
docs.text:
• UI commands, run in ui/: npx tsc -b --noEmit, npx vitest run <file>, npx vitest run.
  • Node modules: in a git worktree, run npm ci in the worktree's own ui/. Never symlink to, or modify, the main checkout's node_modules. Only Task 1 changes dependencies.
  • Backend: never run mvn clean, ./build.sh or any mvn install. Use mvn -q -pl app -am test -Dtest=<Class> -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false. REST changes start in openapi.json.
  • Style: TypeScript and Java use 4-space indentation. Add JSDoc or Javadoc on exported or public functions and components. Use explicit types for exported APIs. Use git grep, not rg.
  • Commits: conventional commit messages, no AI attribution, no push.
  • localStorage keys: prefix with axiom.workbench.. Wrap every access in try/catch, as useTheme.ts does.
  • Flow handle use:
  • Pending change set, apply mode live: call handle.apply(cs).
  • Pending change set, apply mode review: call handle.propose(cs).
  • A stale rejection or onProposalResolved(id, 'stale') resolves as stale.
  • Accept or apply resolves as applied. Reject resolves as rejected.
  • Resolving change sets: every pending change set the UI receives must be resolved exactly once with POST /compositions/{id}/changeset-resolution {turnId, outcome, fromPending}.
  • fromPending is true when the set came from GET /compositions/{id} while the workbench was opening.
  • It is false when the set came from the live SSE composition-changeset event.
  • Saving the workflow:
  • Debounce workflow saves by 500 ms.
  • Flush any pending save before sending a chat message.
  • A save caused by an agent-origin change (meta.origin starts with agent:) carries turnId = the turn that produced the change set.
  • SSE event types:
  • composition-item-changed {compositionId, itemId, contentRevision, author, turnId}
  • composition-turn {compositionId, turnId, state}
  • composition-changeset {compositionId, turnId, changeSet}

All three are top-level events. Consume them with sseClient.subscribe. - Mocking flow-ui in tests: component tests that render the editor mock @apitomy/flow-ui with vi.mock, as WorkflowRunDetailPage.test.tsx does. jsdom cannot render React Flow.

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ApiError, resolveChangeSet, saveItem, subscribeComposition } from "./compositions";
import { sseClient } from "./sse";

function mockFetch(status: number, body: unknown) {
    return vi.spyOn(globalThis, "fetch").mockResolvedValue(new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
        status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    }));
}

describe("compositions api", () => {
    afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());

    it("saves an item with base revision and turn id", async () => {
        const fetchSpy = mockFetch(200, { id: 2, name: "t", type: "tool", contentRevision: "sha256:b", lastAuthor: "ai", changed: true });
        await saveItem(1, 2, { content: { name: "t" }, baseRevision: "sha256:a", turnId: "turn-1" });
        const [url, init] = fetchSpy.mock.calls[0];
        expect(String(url)).toMatch(/\/api\/v1\/compositions\/1\/items\/2$/);
        expect((init as RequestInit).method).toBe("PUT");
        expect(JSON.parse(String((init as RequestInit).body))).toEqual({ content: { name: "t" }, baseRevision: "sha256:a", turnId: "turn-1" });
    });

    it("throws ApiError with status and body on 409", async () => {
        mockFetch(409, { message: "stale", currentRevision: "sha256:z" });
        const error = await saveItem(1, 2, { content: {}, baseRevision: "x" }).catch((e) => e);
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError);
        expect(error.status).toBe(409);
        expect((error.body as { currentRevision: string }).currentRevision).toBe("sha256:z");
    });

    it("posts resolutions with fromPending", async () => {
        const fetchSpy = mockFetch(204, {});
        await resolveChangeSet(1, { turnId: "t", outcome: "stale", fromPending: true });
        expect(JSON.parse(String((fetchSpy.mock.calls[0][1] as RequestInit).body)))
            .toEqual({ turnId: "t", outcome: "stale", fromPending: true });
    });

    it("routes SSE events by composition", () => {
        let listener: ((e: { type: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }) => void) | undefined;
        vi.spyOn(sseClient, "subscribe").mockImplementation((l) => { listener = l; return () => {}; });
        const changeSet = vi.fn();
        subscribeComposition(5, { changeSet });
        listener!({ type: "composition-changeset", data: { compositionId: 6, turnId: "x", changeSet: {} } });
        listener!({ type: "composition-changeset", data: { compositionId: 5, turnId: "y", changeSet: { id: "y" } } });
        expect(changeSet).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(changeSet).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ compositionId: 5, turnId: "y", changeSet: { id: "y" } });
    });
});

A 204 response with a Response body is fine for the mock. The client must not parse JSON on a 204 response.

docs.title: Task 3: Pure workbench logic and preferences
docs.text:
Files: - Create: ui/src/pages/workbench/workbenchLogic.ts and workbenchLogic.test.ts - Create: ui/src/pages/workbench/workbenchPrefs.ts and workbenchPrefs.test.ts

Interfaces (workbenchLogic.ts): - itemStatus(problems: ConfigProblem[] | undefined): "valid" | "warnings" | "errors" | "unknown" - isAiTouchedInTurn(item: CompositionItem, turnId: string | undefined): boolean returns !!turnId && item.lastTurnId === turnId. - isLockedForUser(item: CompositionItem, composition: Composition): boolean is true when turnState === "ai-working", the item is not the workflow, and item.lastTurnId === composition.currentTurnId. - referencedActionTypes(workflow: Workflow): string[] returns the config.actionType values of action nodes, excluding sdk:, deduplicated and in order. - referencedTools(actionType: Record<string, unknown>): string[] handles mcp__axiom-tools__<name> entries, where allowedTools is either a comma- or whitespace-separated string or an array. - publishSelection(items: CompositionItem[], contents: Record<number, Record<string, unknown>>, chosen: number[]): number[] adds, transitively, the changed draft dependencies of chosen items: a workflow brings its action types, and an action type brings its tools. Only items in the composition whose changed is true are added. The result is sorted ascending. - defaultPublishChoice(items: CompositionItem[], statuses: Record<number, ReturnType<typeof itemStatus>>): number[] returns the ids of items that are changed and not in "errors". - undoPlan(result: UndoResult, lastWorkflowSaveTurnId: string | undefined, turnId: string): { replaceWorkflow: Workflow | null; message: string }. It returns replaceWorkflow = result.workflowBefore only when result.workflowRestorable && lastWorkflowSaveTurnId === turnId && result.workflowBefore. Otherwise it is null, with a message explaining that the workflow was left alone. - mergeCatalog(database: ActionTypeDescriptor[], drafts: { name: string; content: Record<string, unknown> }[]): ActionTypeDescriptor[]. Drafts override database entries by value. A draft's inputs and outputs come from content.inputs / content.outputs, and label = name. Database order is kept, with new drafts appended.

Interfaces (workbenchPrefs.ts): - type PaneSizes = { left: number; right: number }, defaulting to { left: 260, right: 380 }. - loadPrefs(): { applyLayout: "place" | "tidy"; focus: boolean; panes: PaneSizes; leftCollapsed: boolean; rightCollapsed: boolean } - savePrefs(partial), which merges into the stored object. - The key is axiom.workbench.prefs. Invalid JSON or values fall back to the defaults. - Pane widths are clamped to [160, 800].

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
    defaultPublishChoice, isLockedForUser, itemStatus, mergeCatalog, publishSelection, referencedActionTypes,
    referencedTools, undoPlan,
} from "./workbenchLogic";
import type { Composition, CompositionItem } from "../../config/compositions";

const item = (id: number, type: CompositionItem["type"], name: string, extra: Partial<CompositionItem> = {}): CompositionItem =>
    ({ id, type, name, contentRevision: "r", lastAuthor: "user", changed: true, ...extra });

describe("workbenchLogic", () => {
    it("derives item status from problems", () => {
        expect(itemStatus(undefined)).toBe("unknown");
        expect(itemStatus([])).toBe("valid");
        expect(itemStatus([{ severity: "warning", code: "c", message: "m" }])).toBe("warnings");
        expect(itemStatus([{ severity: "warning", code: "c", message: "m" }, { severity: "error", code: "c", message: "m" }])).toBe("errors");
    });

    it("locks only non-workflow items touched by the running turn", () => {
        const composition = { turnState: "ai-working", currentTurnId: "t1" } as Composition;
        expect(isLockedForUser(item(1, "tool", "a", { lastTurnId: "t1" }), composition)).toBe(true);
        expect(isLockedForUser(item(2, "tool", "b", { lastTurnId: "t0" }), composition)).toBe(false);

docs.title: Task 8: Workbench page shell (load, session, SSE, panes, focus, break-out, toolbar)
docs.text:
Files: - Create: ui/src/pages/workbench/useWorkbench.ts, ui/src/pages/workbench/useWorkbench.test.tsx - Replace: ui/src/pages/workbench/WorkbenchPage.tsx; create WorkbenchPage.css and WorkbenchPage.test.tsx

Interfaces: - useWorkbench(compositionId: number) returns a WorkbenchState:

export interface WorkbenchState {
    composition: Composition | null;
    items: CompositionItem[];
    /** Item content by item id, loaded on demand (the workflow is loaded eagerly). */
    contents: Record<number, Record<string, unknown>>;
    /** Problems by item id from POST /validate (refreshed on load, after saves and after turns; debounced 800 ms). */
    problems: Record<number, ConfigProblem[]>;
    /** Pending change set to apply, with where it came from. Cleared by markPendingHandled. */
    pending: { turnId: string; changeSet: ChangeSet; fromPending: boolean } | null;
    /** The last AI turn that completed in this browser session (for Undo AI turn and AI badges). */
    lastCompletedTurnId: string | undefined;
    sessionError: string | null;
    loadContent(itemId: number): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
    refreshItems(): Promise<void>;
    refreshComposition(): Promise<void>;
    setContent(itemId: number, content: Record<string, unknown>, revision: string): void;
    markPendingHandled(): void;
    retrySession(): Promise<void>;
}

Behaviour: - On mount: 1. Fetch the composition and its items, and load the workflow's content. 2. Call ensureCompositionSession. A 503 sets sessionError and does not block editing. 3. Run validateComposition. 4. If composition.pendingChangeSet and pendingTurnId are set, set pending with fromPending: true. - SSE, through subscribeComposition: - itemChanged: refresh the items. If the item's content is loaded and the event's revision differs from the loaded revision, reload that content. Then debounce a re-validation. - turn: refresh the composition. When state is idle, set lastCompletedTurnId = turnId and re-validate. - changeSet: set pending with fromPending: false. - On SSE reconnect (sseClient.onReconnect): refresh the composition and items, and adopt a pending change set from the server if one has not already been handled.

WorkbenchPage layout (CSS grid): - Toolbar: - composition name - apply mode toggle (Apply live / Review changes; updateComposition with applyMode) - layout preference (Place new nodes / Tidy after AI changes; workbenchPrefs) - Focus (Ctrl+Shift+F; toggles ?focus=1) - Break out: opens /workbench/:id?chrome=none in a new window and shows an inline notice "Opened in another window" with a Bring back here button that dismisses it - Publish… - Left pane: CompositionTree (Task 9). Centre: tabs (Tasks 10 and 11) with ProblemsStrip below them (Task 12). Right: ChatPane (Task 12). - Splitters: two draggable splitters, built like the resize handle in AssistantSubagentPanel.tsx:70-90. Widths come from and are saved to workbenchPrefs. Each side pane has a collapse control and shrinks to a 32 px rail; the chat rail shows a pulsing dot while the AI is working. Maximize canvas collapses both. - Tabs: the workflow tab is always open. Item tabs open on demand, close with ✕, and the open set is kept in component state.

In this task the left, centre and right panes may render minimal placeholders, which Tasks 9 to 12 replace, except the workflow tab placeholder must show the workflow item's name.

docs.text:
Files: - Create in ui/src/pages/workbench/: CompositionTree.tsx, RevisionList.tsx, PublishDialog.tsx, and CompositionTree.test.tsx, PublishDialog.test.tsx - Modify: WorkbenchPage.tsx (wire them in)

Interfaces: - CompositionTree props: - items, problems, composition, lastCompletedTurnId, selectedItemId - onOpen(itemId) - onAdd(type: "action-type" | "tool"), which opens an add dialog: a New name, or Existing, a select filled from fetchActionTypes(1, 1000) / fetchTools(...) (reuse existing api.ts functions) - onRestored(item) - Row rendering: - Group order: Workflow, Action types, Tools. - Each row shows a status icon from itemStatus (check, warning or error icon; nothing for unknown), an AI label when isAiTouchedInTurn(item, lastCompletedTurnId), and a dot with the tooltip "Unpublished changes" when item.changed. - Items locked by isLockedForUser show a lock icon. - Revisions: selecting an item shows RevisionList below the tree. - It loads listRevisions and shows author (You / AI), turn and time, newest first. - Restore calls restoreRevision, then onRestored(item). - For the workflow, WorkbenchPage applies a restored workflow through the editor handle with replace(content, 'host') (Task 10), so the canvas matches. - PublishDialog props: compositionId, items, contents (it loads missing contents itself for dependency checks), problems, onPublished(result) and onClose. - Checkboxes start from defaultPublishChoice. Each change runs publishSelection to add dependencies, and dependency-added rows show "required by …". - Publish calls publishComposition(id, chosen, false): - 409: show the message and a Publish anyway button, which calls again with force = true. - 422: list problems by key. - Success: show "Created N, updated M", call onPublished, and refresh items.

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { PublishDialog } from "./PublishDialog";
import * as c from "../../config/compositions";

const items = [
    { id: 1, type: "workflow", name: "wf", contentRevision: "r", lastAuthor: "user", changed: true },
    { id: 2, type: "action-type", name: "at", contentRevision: "r", lastAuthor: "ai", changed: true },
] as c.CompositionItem[];
const contents = { 1: { nodes: [{ id: "a", type: "action", config: { actionType: "at" } }], edges: [] }, 2: { name: "at" } };

describe("PublishDialog", () => {
    it("auto-selects dependencies and forces after a conflict", async () => {
        const publish = vi.spyOn(c, "publishComposition")
            .mockRejectedValueOnce(new c.ApiError("Changed outside the workbench since loaded: action-type/at", 409, {}))
            .mockResolvedValueOnce({ created: 1, updated: 1, items: [] });
        const onPublished = vi.fn();
        render(<PublishDialog compositionId={9} items={items} contents={contents} problems={{ 1: [], 2: [] }}
            onPublished={onPublished} onClose={() => {}} />);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText("at"));
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText("at"));
        expect((screen.getByLabelText("at") as HTMLInputElement).checked).toBe(true);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^publish$/i }));
        await screen.findByText(/changed outside the workbench/i);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /publish anyway/i }));
        await waitFor(() => expect(onPublished).toHaveBeenCalled());
        expect(publish).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(9, [1, 2], true);
    });

    it("lists blocking problems on 422", async () => {
        vi.spyOn(c, "publishComposition").mockRejectedValue(new c.ApiError("Cannot publish", 422,
            { message: "Cannot publish", problems: { "workflow/wf": [{ severity: "error", code: "x", message: "broken node" }] } }));
        render(<PublishDialog compositionId={9} items={items} contents={contents} problems={{}} onPublished={() => {}} onClose={() => {}} />);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^publish$/i }));
        expect(await screen.findByText(/broken node/)).toBeTruthy();
    });
});

In the first test, "at" is unchecked and then checked again. Because the workflow (checked by default) requires it, it must stay checked (dependency-locked). Implement it so that a required dependency's checkbox is checked and disabled; then the double click is harmless.

Write CompositionTree.test.tsx along the same lines. It must assert: - group order; - the status icons (query by aria-label "valid", "warnings", "errors"); - the AI label for the last turn; - the unpublished dot; - that clicking a row calls onOpen.
