import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import {
    Alert, Button, Flex, FlexItem, Form, FormGroup, HelperText, HelperTextItem, Switch, TextArea, TextInput,
    Title, Tooltip,
} from "@patternfly/react-core";
import { TrashIcon } from "@patternfly/react-icons";
import { previewSubscriptionFilter, type SubscriptionPreviewResponse } from "../config/api";
import type { ValidationMessage } from "./ActionTypeEditor";

const PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS: number = 500;
const PREVIEW_LIMIT: number = 200;

type Rule = { type: string; workflowDefinitionName?: string };

/** Props of {@link SubscriptionItemEditor}. */
export interface SubscriptionItemEditorProps {
    /** The item content: `{name, description, filterExpression, routing, labels}`. */
    value: Record<string, unknown>;
    /** Called with the whole new content on every change. */
    onChange(value: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    /** Disables editing (e.g. while the AI edits the item). */
    readOnly?: boolean;
    /** Server validation problems to show above the form. */
    problems?: ValidationMessage[];
    /** Name of the composition's workflow; create-workflow rules always target it. */
    workflowName: string;
    /** Whether the item has been published (the Enabled switch is shown only then). */
    published: boolean;
    /** Whether the composition's workflow is published (the switch is disabled otherwise). */
    workflowPublished: boolean;
    /** Whether the published subscription is enabled. */
    enabled: boolean;
    /** Called when the user flips the Enabled switch. */
    onToggleEnabled(enabled: boolean): void;
}

/**
 * Editor for a workbench subscription item: fields, routing rules bound to the composition's workflow, a preview
 * of the recent events the filter matches, and (once published) the Enabled switch.
 */
export function SubscriptionItemEditor(props: SubscriptionItemEditorProps) {
    const { value, onChange, readOnly, problems, workflowName } = props;
    const routing: Rule[] = (value.routing as Rule[] | undefined) ?? [];
    const filter: string = (value.filterExpression as string | undefined) ?? "";
    const [preview, setPreview] = useState<SubscriptionPreviewResponse | null>(null);
    const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            previewSubscriptionFilter({ filterExpression: filter, limit: PREVIEW_LIMIT })
                .then((r) => { setPreview(r); setPreviewError(null); })
                .catch((e: unknown) => setPreviewError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
        }, PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [filter]);

    const set = (field: string, v: unknown) => onChange({ ...value, [field]: v });
    const setRouting = (rules: Rule[]) => set("routing", rules);
    const matches = (preview?.results ?? []).filter((r) => r.matched);

    return (
        <div className="axiom-subscription-item-editor">
            {props.published && (
                <Flex justifyContent={{ default: "justifyContentFlexEnd" }}>
                    <FlexItem>
                        <Tooltip content="Publish the workflow before enabling this subscription"
                            trigger={props.workflowPublished ? "manual" : "mouseenter focus"}>
                            <Switch id="subscription-enabled" label="Enabled" aria-label="Enabled"
                                isChecked={props.enabled} isDisabled={!props.workflowPublished}
                                onChange={(_e, checked) => props.onToggleEnabled(checked)} />
                        </Tooltip>
                    </FlexItem>
                </Flex>
            )}
            {(problems ?? []).length > 0 && (
                <Alert isInline variant="warning" title="Problems">
                    <ul>{(problems ?? []).map((p, i) => <li key={i}>{p.field ? `${p.field}: ` : ""}{p.message}</li>)}</ul>
                </Alert>
            )}
            <Form onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
                <FormGroup label="Name" fieldId="subscription-name">
                    <TextInput id="subscription-name" value={(value.name as string) ?? ""} isDisabled={readOnly}
                        onChange={(_e, v) => set("name", v)} />
                </FormGroup>
                <FormGroup label="Description" fieldId="subscription-description">
                    <TextArea id="subscription-description" value={(value.description as string) ?? ""}
                        isDisabled={readOnly} rows={2} onChange={(_e, v) => set("description", v)} />
                </FormGroup>
                <FormGroup label="Filter expression" fieldId="subscription-filter">
                    <TextArea id="subscription-filter" className="axiom-monospace" value={filter} rows={4}
                        isDisabled={readOnly} onChange={(_e, v) => set("filterExpression", v)} />
                </FormGroup>
                <FormGroup label="Routing" fieldId="subscription-routing">
                    {routing.map((rule, i) => (
                        <Flex key={i} alignItems={{ default: "alignItemsCenter" }}>
                            <FlexItem>
                                {rule.type === "create-workflow" ? `Starts workflow ${workflowName}`
                                    : "Delivers events to waiting runs (receive-event nodes)"}
                            </FlexItem>
                            <FlexItem>
                                <Button variant="plain" aria-label={`Remove rule ${i + 1}`} isDisabled={readOnly}
                                    icon={<TrashIcon />} onClick={() => setRouting(routing.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} />
                            </FlexItem>
                        </Flex>
                    ))}
                    <Flex>
                        <Button variant="link" isInline isDisabled={readOnly}
                            onClick={() => setRouting([...routing,
                                { type: "create-workflow", workflowDefinitionName: workflowName }])}>
                            Add start rule
                        </Button>
                        <Button variant="link" isInline isDisabled={readOnly}

docs.title: Built-in Session Template Overrides Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Let users override model, engine and environment on built-in AI session templates, with a reset-to-defaults action.

Architecture: A sparse session_template_override table stores per-built-in overrides. SessionTemplateService merges overrides onto classpath defaults on every read, so session creation picks them up without changes. A new REST sub-resource /assistant/templates/{templateId}/overrides (contract-first) exposes GET/PUT/DELETE; the UI unlocks the three fields for built-ins.

Tech Stack: Java 25, Quarkus, Hibernate Panache, Flyway, JAX-RS (generated from OpenAPI), JUnit 5 + RestAssured, React + PatternFly + TypeScript.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-builtin-template-overrides-design.md

docs.title: Global Constraints
docs.text:
• Only model, engine, environment are overridable. All other built-in fields remain locked.
  • Null override field = use built-in default. environment override replaces (does not merge) the default.
  • Saving overrides with all three fields null/empty deletes the override row.
  • Override rows whose template_id is not a current built-in are ignored at read time.
  • Overrides are NOT part of configuration packs (ImportExportService unchanged).
  • Existing PUT/DELETE /assistant/templates/{templateId} keep returning 403 for built-ins.
  • API-first: edit common/api/src/main/resources/openapi.json before Java; REST impl uses generated beans from io.apitomy.axiom.api.beans; never add @Path on impl classes.
  • Java style: 4-space indent, Javadoc on public methods, explicit types (no ambiguous var), JUnit 5.

    @Test
    void builtInWithoutOverridesHasNoOverriddenFields() {

    @Test

        assertEquals("my-model", t.model());
        assertEquals("opencode", t.engine());
        assertEquals("{\"FOO\":\"bar\"}", t.environment());
        assertEquals(Set.of("model", "engine", "environment"), t.overriddenFields());
        assertTrue(t.builtIn());
        assertTrue(t.systemPrompt().length() > 0);

                .filter(x -> x.templateId().equals(BUILT_IN)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals("my-model", listed.model());

    @Test
    void partialOverrideOnlyReportsSetFields() {
        service.setOverrides(BUILT_IN, new SessionTemplateService.TemplateOverrides("m", null, null));
        SessionTemplateService.SessionTemplate t = service.getTemplate(BUILT_IN);

        assertNull(empty.model());

        service.setOverrides(BUILT_IN, new SessionTemplateService.TemplateOverrides(" ", null, "{}"));
        assertEquals(0L, SessionTemplateOverrideEntity.count());

        service.clearOverrides(BUILT_IN);
        assertNull(service.getTemplate(BUILT_IN).model());

        assertThrows(SessionTemplateService.TemplateNotFoundException.class,

package io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities;

import io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.panache.PanacheEntity;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

/**
 * Stores user overrides for a built-in AI Assistant session template. Only the
 * overridable fields are persisted; a null value means "use the built-in default".
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "session_template_override")
public class SessionTemplateOverrideEntity extends PanacheEntity {

    /** The built-in template identifier these overrides apply to. */
    @Column(name = "template_id", nullable = false, unique = true)
    public String templateId;

    /** Optional AI model override. */
    @Column(name = "model")
    public String model;

    /** Optional interactive engine override. */
    @Column(name = "engine")
    public String engine;

    /** Optional JSON object of environment variables; replaces the built-in default. */
    @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    public String environment;

    /**
     * Finds the override row for a template.
     *
     * @param templateId the built-in template identifier
     * @return the override entity, or null if none exists
     */
    public static SessionTemplateOverrideEntity findByTemplateId(String templateId) {
        return find("templateId", templateId).firstResult();
    }
}

5e. Add the override API methods (after deleteTemplate):

    /**
     * Returns the stored overrides for a built-in template.
     *
     * @param templateId the built-in template identifier
     * @return the overrides; all fields null when none are stored
     * @throws TemplateNotFoundException if the template does not exist
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the template is not built-in
     */
    public TemplateOverrides getOverrides(String templateId) {
        requireBuiltIn(templateId);
        SessionTemplateOverrideEntity entity = SessionTemplateOverrideEntity.findByTemplateId(templateId);
        if (entity == null) {
            return new TemplateOverrides(null, null, null);
        }
        return new TemplateOverrides(entity.model, entity.engine, entity.environment);
    }

    /**
     * Replaces the overrides for a built-in template. Blank values are treated as null; when
     * every field is null the stored overrides are removed.
     *
     * @param templateId the built-in template identifier
     * @param overrides the new overrides
     * @return the built-in template with overrides applied
     * @throws TemplateNotFoundException if the template does not exist
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the template is not built-in
     */
    @Transactional
    public SessionTemplate setOverrides(String templateId, TemplateOverrides overrides) {
        requireBuiltIn(templateId);
        String model = blankToNull(overrides.model());
        String engine = blankToNull(overrides.engine());
        String environment = normalizeEnvironment(overrides.environment());
        SessionTemplateOverrideEntity entity = SessionTemplateOverrideEntity.findByTemplateId(templateId);
        if (model == null && engine == null && environment == null) {
            if (entity != null) {
                entity.delete();
            }
            return builtInTemplates.get(templateId);
        }
        if (entity == null) {
            entity = new SessionTemplateOverrideEntity();
            entity.templateId = templateId;
        }
        entity.model = model;
        entity.engine = engine;
        entity.environment = environment;
        entity.persist();
        return applyOverrides(builtInTemplates.get(templateId), entity);
    }

    /**
     * Removes all overrides for a built-in template, restoring its defaults.
     *
     * @param templateId the built-in template identifier
     * @throws TemplateNotFoundException if the template does not exist
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the template is not built-in
     */
    @Transactional
    public void clearOverrides(String templateId) {
        requireBuiltIn(templateId);
        SessionTemplateOverrideEntity.delete("templateId", templateId);
    }

    private void requireBuiltIn(String templateId) {
        if (isBuiltIn(templateId)) {
            return;
        }
        if (SessionTemplateEntity.find("templateId", templateId).firstResult() != null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Overrides are only supported for built-in templates: " + templateId);
        }
        throw new TemplateNotFoundException(templateId);
    }

    private SessionTemplate applyOverrides(SessionTemplate base, SessionTemplateOverrideEntity o) {
        if (o == null) {
            return base;
        }
        Set<String> overridden = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        String model = base.model();
        String engine = base.engine();
        String environment = base.environment();
        if (o.model != null) {
            model = o.model;
            overridden.add("model");
        }
        if (o.engine != null) {
            engine = o.engine;
            overridden.add("engine");
        }
        if (o.environment != null) {
            environment = o.environment;
            overridden.add("environment");
        }
        return new SessionTemplate(base.templateId(), base.name(), base.description(), base.systemPrompt(),
                base.welcomeMessage(), base.initialMessage(), base.workingDirectory(), model, engine,
                base.initScript(), base.initScriptType(), environment, base.mcpServers(),
                base.allowedTools(), base.builtIn(), base.capabilities(), Set.copyOf(overridden));
    }

    private static String blankToNull(String value) {
        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeEnvironment(String json) {
        if (json == null || json.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            JsonNode node = objectMapper.readTree(json);
            return node.isObject() && node.size() > 0 ? node.toString() : null;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid environment JSON", e);
        }
    }

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.IOException;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsInAnyOrder;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.empty;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;

import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.nullValue;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.atLeastOnce;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;

/**
 * REST tests for the built-in session template overrides sub-resource.
 */
@QuarkusTest
class SessionTemplateOverridesResourceTest {

    private static final String BASE = "/api/v1/assistant/templates";
    private static final String BUILT_IN = "general-assistant";

    @InjectMock
    InteractiveSessionDriverFactory interactiveSessionDriverFactory;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanUp() {
        given().delete(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN);
    }

    @Test
    void getReturnsEmptyOverridesByDefault() {
        given().get(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("model", nullValue())
                .body("engine", nullValue())
                .body("environment", nullValue());
        given().get(BASE + "/{id}", BUILT_IN)
                .then().statusCode(200).body("overriddenFields", empty());
    }

    @Test
    void putAppliesOverridesAndReportsOverriddenFields() {
        given().contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body("{\"model\":\"m1\",\"environment\":{\"FOO\":\"bar\"}}")
                .put(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("model", equalTo("m1"))
                .body("environment.FOO", equalTo("bar"))
                .body("builtIn", equalTo(true))
                .body("overriddenFields", containsInAnyOrder("model", "environment"));

        given().get(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN)
                .then().statusCode(200).body("model", equalTo("m1"));
        given().get(BASE)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("find { it.templateId == 'general-assistant' }.overriddenFields", hasItem("model"));
    }

    @Test
    void deleteResetsToDefaults() {
        given().contentType(ContentType.JSON).body("{\"model\":\"m1\"}")
                .put(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN).then().statusCode(200);
        given().delete(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN).then().statusCode(204);
        given().get(BASE + "/{id}", BUILT_IN)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("model", nullValue())
                .body("overriddenFields", empty());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownTemplateReturns404() {
        given().get(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", "nope").then().statusCode(404);
        given().contentType(ContentType.JSON).body("{\"model\":\"m\"}")
                .put(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", "nope").then().statusCode(404);
        given().delete(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", "nope").then().statusCode(404);
    }

    @Test
    void userTemplateReturns400() {
        String id = given().contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body("{\"name\":\"u\",\"description\":\"d\",\"systemPrompt\":\"p\"}")
                .post(BASE).then().statusCode(201).extract().path("templateId");
        try {
            given().get(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", id).then().statusCode(400);
            given().contentType(ContentType.JSON).body("{\"model\":\"m\"}")
                    .put(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", id).then().statusCode(400);
            given().delete(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", id).then().statusCode(400);
        } finally {
            given().delete(BASE + "/{id}", id);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void existingBuiltInPutStillForbidden() {
        given().contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body("{\"name\":\"x\",\"description\":\"d\",\"systemPrompt\":\"p\"}")
                .put(BASE + "/{id}", BUILT_IN).then().statusCode(403);
    }

    @Test
    void sessionCreationUsesOverriddenEngine() throws IOException {
        String engine = given().get("/api/v1/system/config").then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("engines.find { it.supportsInteractiveSessions }.type");
        given().contentType(ContentType.JSON).body("{\"engine\":\"" + engine + "\"}")
                .put(BASE + "/{id}/overrides", BUILT_IN).then().statusCode(200);

        when(interactiveSessionDriverFactory.createDriver(any())).thenAnswer(i -> {
            InteractiveSessionDriver driver = mock(InteractiveSessionDriver.class);
            when(driver.getStatus()).thenReturn(AssistantSession.Status.RUNNING);
            return driver;
        });
        String sessionId = given().contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body("{\"templateId\":\"" + BUILT_IN + "\",\"name\":\"override-test\"}")
                .post("/api/v1/assistant/sessions")
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().path("id");
        try {
            ArgumentCaptor<InteractiveSessionDriverFactory.DriverRequest> captor =
                    ArgumentCaptor.forClass(InteractiveSessionDriverFactory.DriverRequest.class);
            verify(interactiveSessionDriverFactory, atLeastOnce()).createDriver(captor.capture());
            assertEquals(engine, captor.getValue().engineType());
        } finally {
            given().delete("/api/v1/assistant/sessions/{id}", sessionId);
        }
    }
}

Note: confirm the system config path by checking fetchSystemConfig in ui/src/config/api.ts; adjust /api/v1/system/config if it differs.

    const response = await fetch(

docs.title: Event Schema Registry Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Give every Axiom event type a JSON Schema, validate every ingested event against it at runtime (saving invalid events with their errors), expose the schemas over REST, and make event IDs unique per event source.

Architecture: Hand-written schema files in core (envelope.json, defs.json, payloads/<type>.json) are assembled at startup by EventSchemaRegistry into one self-contained schema per event type. EventStreamService.persistEvent validates each new event and stores errors in stream_event.validation_errors. A Flyway migration replaces the global unique index on source_event_id with one on (event_source_id, source_event_id).

Tech Stack: Java 21, Quarkus 3.40, Jackson, com.networknt:json-schema-validator 1.5.9 (draft 2020-12), Flyway/H2, JUnit 5, RestAssured.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-21-event-schemas-and-jira-ingestion-design.md (section "Plan 1").

docs.title: Global Constraints
docs.text:
• REST changes are contract-first: edit common/api/src/main/resources/openapi.json, run mvn install on common/api, implement the generated interface. No @Path on impl classes.
  • /event-* paths are generated into io.apitomy.axiom.api.EventResource, which is implemented by app/src/main/java/io/apitomy/axiom/app/rest/EventSourcesResourceImpl.java. The schema endpoints go there.
  • sourceData is never validated (unconstrained in the schema).
  • Invalid events are saved, flagged, logged; ingestion never stops because of validation.
  • Schema load or assembly failure fails startup.
  • The sourceEventId format does not change.
  • Java style: 4-space indent, Javadoc on public types and methods, explicit types (no var), JUnit 5.
  • Never test against ports 9191/9090; live checks use ./dev.sh --skip-ui --portOffset=500 with a temporary AXIOM_HOME and --dataDir.

package io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.schema;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.Actor;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.EventType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedEvent;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedIssue;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.payloads.IssueClosedPayload;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class EventSchemaRegistryTest {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    private static EventSchemaRegistry registry;

    @BeforeAll
    static void load() {
        registry = new EventSchemaRegistry(MAPPER);
    }

    static NormalizedEvent closedEvent(String state, String createdAt) {
        Actor actor = new Actor("u1", "User One", null, null);
        NormalizedIssue issue = new NormalizedIssue("PROJ-1", "Title", "Body", state, "Closed", actor,
                List.of(), List.of("bug"), null, "https://jira.example/browse/PROJ-1",
                createdAt, "2026-10-21T14:54:06.982Z", null);

package io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.schema;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema;
import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory;
import com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion;
import com.networknt.schema.ValidationMessage;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.EventType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedEvent;
import io.quarkus.runtime.Startup;
import jakarta.enterprise.context.ApplicationScoped;
import jakarta.inject.Inject;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.TreeMap;

/**
 * Loads the hand-written event JSON Schemas from {@code schemas/events/} on the classpath, assembles one
 * self-contained schema per {@link EventType}, and validates normalized events against them.
 * Fails at construction (and therefore at startup) if any schema is missing or invalid.
 */
@ApplicationScoped
@Startup
public class EventSchemaRegistry {

    static final String BASE = "schemas/events/";

    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private Map<String, ObjectNode> assembled;
    private Map<String, JsonSchema> compiled;

    /**
     * Loads and compiles every event schema.
     *
     * @param objectMapper mapper used to serialize events before validation
     * @throws IllegalStateException if a schema file is missing, unreadable or invalid
     */
    @Inject
    public EventSchemaRegistry(ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
        this.assembled = new TreeMap<>();
        this.compiled = new HashMap<>();
        JsonSchemaFactory factory = JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012);
        ObjectNode envelope = load("envelope.json");
        JsonNode defs = load("defs.json").path("$defs");
        for (EventType type : EventType.values()) {
            String name = type.value();
            ObjectNode schema = assemble(envelope, defs, load("payloads/" + name + ".json"), name);
            try {
                JsonSchema jsonSchema = factory.getSchema(schema);
                jsonSchema.initializeValidators();
                compiled.put(name, jsonSchema);
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid event schema for " + name + ": " + e.getMessage(), e);
            }
            assembled.put(name, schema);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Lists every event type that has a schema.
     *
     * @return summaries sorted by event type
     */
    public List<EventSchemaSummary> eventTypes() {
        List<EventSchemaSummary> result = new ArrayList<>();
        assembled.forEach((type, schema) ->
                result.add(new EventSchemaSummary(type, schema.path("description").asText(""))));
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the assembled schema for an event type.
     *
     * @param eventType the event type, e.g. {@code issue.closed}
     * @return a deep copy of the schema, or empty if the type is unknown
     */
    public Optional<JsonNode> schemaFor(String eventType) {
        ObjectNode schema = assembled.get(eventType);
        return schema == null ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(schema.deepCopy());
    }

    /**
     * Validates a normalized event.
     *
     * @param event the event
     * @return validation errors, sorted; empty if the event is valid
     */
    public List<String> validate(NormalizedEvent event) {
        return validate(objectMapper.valueToTree(event));
    }

    /**
     * Validates the JSON form of an event.
     *
     * @param eventJson the serialized event
     * @return validation errors, sorted; empty if the event is valid
     */
    public List<String> validate(JsonNode eventJson) {
        String type = eventJson.path("type").asText(null);
        JsonSchema schema = type == null ? null : compiled.get(type);
        if (schema == null) {
            return List.of("$.type: unknown event type '" + type + "'");
        }
        return schema.validate(eventJson).stream().map(ValidationMessage::getMessage).sorted().toList();
    }

    private static ObjectNode assemble(ObjectNode envelope, JsonNode defs, ObjectNode payload, String type) {
        ObjectNode schema = envelope.deepCopy();
        schema.put("title", type);
        schema.put("description", payload.path("description").asText(""));
        schema.set("$defs", defs.deepCopy());
        ObjectNode properties = (ObjectNode) schema.get("properties");
        ((ObjectNode) properties.get("type")).put("const", type);
        ObjectNode payloadSchema = payload.deepCopy();
        payloadSchema.remove("$schema");
        properties.set("payload", payloadSchema);
        return schema;
    }

    private ObjectNode load(String path) {
        try (InputStream in = EventSchemaRegistry.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(BASE + path)) {
            if (in == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Missing event schema resource: " + BASE + path);
            }
            return (ObjectNode) objectMapper.readTree(in);
        } catch (IOException | ClassCastException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unreadable event schema resource: " + BASE + path, e);
        }
    }
}

Note: load uses objectMapper, so the field is assigned first in the constructor.

package io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.schema;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonSubTypes;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.Actor;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.Change;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.Commit;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.EventType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedComment;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedIssue;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedLabel;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedPullRequest;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedReview;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.payloads.EventPayload;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.lang.reflect.RecordComponent;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

/** Guards against the hand-written schemas drifting from the Java event model. */
class EventSchemaDriftTest {

    private static final EventSchemaRegistry REGISTRY = new EventSchemaRegistry(new ObjectMapper());

    @Test
    void payloadFilesMatchEventTypesExactly() {
        File dir = new File("src/main/resources/schemas/events/payloads");
        Set<String> files = Arrays.stream(dir.list()).map(n -> n.replace(".json", ""))
                .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
        Set<String> types = Arrays.stream(EventType.values()).map(EventType::value)
                .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
        assertEquals(types, files);
    }

    @Test
    void sharedDefsCoverEveryRecordComponent() {
        JsonNode defs = REGISTRY.schemaFor("push").orElseThrow().path("$defs");
        Map<String, Class<?>> records = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        records.put("Actor", Actor.class);
        records.put("Change", Change.class);
        records.put("Commit", Commit.class);
        records.put("CommitAuthor", Commit.CommitAuthor.class);
        records.put("NormalizedComment", NormalizedComment.class);
        records.put("NormalizedIssue", NormalizedIssue.class);
        records.put("NormalizedLabel", NormalizedLabel.class);
        records.put("NormalizedPullRequest", NormalizedPullRequest.class);
        records.put("NormalizedReview", NormalizedReview.class);
        List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
        records.forEach((def, type) -> compare(def, type, defs.path(def).path("properties"), Set.of(), problems));
        assertEquals(List.of(), problems);
    }

    @Test
    void payloadSchemasCoverEveryPayloadRecordComponent() {
        List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonSubTypes.Type sub : EventPayload.class.getAnnotation(JsonSubTypes.class).value()) {
            JsonNode props = REGISTRY.schemaFor(sub.name()).orElseThrow().at("/properties/payload/properties");
            compare(sub.name(), sub.value(), props, Set.of("type"), problems);
        }
        assertEquals(List.of(), problems);
    }

    private static void compare(String name, Class<?> type, JsonNode props, Set<String> extraAllowed,
                                List<String> problems) {
        Set<String> components = Arrays.stream(type.getRecordComponents()).map(RecordComponent::getName)
                .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
        Set<String> schemaProps = new TreeSet<>();
        for (Iterator<String> it = props.fieldNames(); it.hasNext(); ) {
            schemaProps.add(it.next());
        }
        for (String c : components) {
            if (!schemaProps.contains(c)) {
                problems.add(name + ": schema missing property '" + c + "'");
            }
        }
        for (String p : schemaProps) {
            if (!components.contains(p) && !extraAllowed.contains(p)) {
                problems.add(name + ": schema property '" + p + "' has no record component");
            }
        }
    }
}

package io.apitomy.axiom.events.github.v2;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedEvent;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.schema.EventSchemaRegistry;

import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

/** Test normalizer that fails the test if any produced event does not match its JSON Schema. */
class ValidatingGitHubNormalizer extends GitHubEventNormalizerV2 {

    private static final EventSchemaRegistry REGISTRY = new EventSchemaRegistry(new ObjectMapper());

    ValidatingGitHubNormalizer(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        super(mapper);
    }

    @Override
    public NormalizedEvent normalize(JsonNode event, String eventSourceId, String baseUrl, JsonNode fullPr) {
        NormalizedEvent result = super.normalize(event, eventSourceId, baseUrl, fullPr);
        if (result != null) {
            assertEquals(List.of(), REGISTRY.validate(result), "schema errors for " + result.type().value());
        }
        return result;
    }
}

In JiraEventNormalizerV2, next to formatTimestamp:

    /**
     * Converts a Jira timestamp (e.g. {@code 2026-10-21T14:53:07.835+0000}) to ISO-8601 UTC ({@code …Z}).
     *
     * @param jiraTimestamp the Jira timestamp, may be null
     * @return the ISO form, null for null input, or the input unchanged if it cannot be parsed
     */
    static String isoTimestamp(String jiraTimestamp) {
        if (jiraTimestamp == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Instant parsed = parseJiraTimestamp(jiraTimestamp);
        return parsed != null ? parsed.toString() : jiraTimestamp;
    }

Replace textOrNull(fields, "created") / textOrNull(fields, "updated") inside mapIssue (~321-322) with isoTimestamp(textOrNull(fields, "created")) / isoTimestamp(textOrNull(fields, "updated")), and textOrNull(comment, "created") / textOrNull(comment, "updated") inside mapComment (~359-360) the same way. If mapIssue passes a closedAt from a raw field, wrap it too. Note: Instant.toString() drops a .000 fraction (…:07Z); the schema accepts both.

package io.apitomy.axiom.app;

import io.apitomy.axiom.core.entities.StreamEventEntity;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.Actor;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.EventType;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedEvent;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.NormalizedIssue;
import io.apitomy.axiom.core.events.model.payloads.IssueClosedPayload;
import io.apitomy.axiom.events.core.EventStreamService;
import io.apitomy.axiom.events.core.PersistOutcome;
import io.quarkus.narayana.jta.QuarkusTransaction;
import io.quarkus.test.junit.QuarkusTest;
import jakarta.inject.Inject;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@QuarkusTest
class EventStreamValidationTest {

    @Inject
    EventStreamService service;

    static NormalizedEvent event(String eventSourceId, String sourceEventId, String createdAt) {
        Actor actor = new Actor("u1", "User One", null, null);
        NormalizedIssue issue = new NormalizedIssue("PROJ-1", "Title", null, "closed", "Closed", actor,
                List.of(), List.of(), null, "https://jira.example/browse/PROJ-1", createdAt, null, null);
        return new NormalizedEvent(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), sourceEventId, "jira", eventSourceId,
                EventType.ISSUE_CLOSED, "https://jira.example/browse/PROJ-1", "2026-10-21T14:54:06Z",
                actor, new IssueClosedPayload(issue), null);
    }

    static StreamEventEntity stored(String eventSourceId, String sourceEventId) {
        return QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().call(() -> StreamEventEntity
                .<StreamEventEntity>find("eventSourceId = ?1 and sourceEventId = ?2", eventSourceId, sourceEventId)
                .firstResult());
    }

    @AfterEach
    void cleanup() {
        QuarkusTransaction.requiringNew().run(() ->
                StreamEventEntity.delete("eventSourceId in ?1", List.of("val-a", "val-b")));
    }

    @Test
    void validEventIsPersistedWithoutErrors() {
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.PERSISTED, service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-1", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z")));
        assertNull(stored("val-a", "P-1-1").validationErrors);
    }

    @Test
    void invalidEventIsPersistedWithErrors() {
        PersistOutcome outcome = service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-2", "2026-10-21T14:53:07.835+0000"));
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.PERSISTED_INVALID, outcome);
        String errors = stored("val-a", "P-1-2").validationErrors;
        assertTrue(errors.startsWith("[") && errors.contains("$.payload.issue.createdAt"), errors);
    }

    @Test
    void sameSourceEventIdInTwoSourcesIsStoredTwice() {
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.PERSISTED, service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-3", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z")));
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.PERSISTED, service.persistEvent(event("val-b", "P-1-3", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z")));
    }

    @Test
    void sameSourceEventIdInOneSourceIsDuplicate() {
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.PERSISTED, service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-4", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z")));
        assertEquals(PersistOutcome.DUPLICATE, service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-4", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z")));
    }

    @Test
    void existingIdsAreScopedToTheSource() {
        service.persistEvent(event("val-a", "P-1-5", "2026-10-21T14:53:07Z"));
        assertEquals(Set.of("P-1-5"), service.existingSourceEventIds("val-a", List.of("P-1-5", "P-1-6")));
        assertEquals(Set.of(), service.existingSourceEventIds("val-b", List.of("P-1-5")));
    }
}

package io.apitomy.axiom.events.core;

/** Result of {@link EventStreamService#persistEvent}. */
public enum PersistOutcome {
    /** Stored; passed schema validation. */
    PERSISTED,
    /** Stored; failed schema validation (errors saved with the event). */
    PERSISTED_INVALID,
    /** Not stored; the event source already has an event with this source event ID. */
    DUPLICATE;

    /**
     * Whether the event was stored.
     *
     * @return true for {@link #PERSISTED} and {@link #PERSISTED_INVALID}
     */
    public boolean persisted() {
        return this != DUPLICATE;
    }
}

        long existing = StreamEventEntity.count("eventSourceId = ?1 and sourceEventId = ?2",

        if (existing > 0) {
            LOG.debugf("Skipping duplicate event: %s (sourceEventId: %s)",

            return PersistOutcome.DUPLICATE;

        List<String> errors = validationErrors(event);
        if (!errors.isEmpty()) {
            entity.validationErrors = toJson(errors);
            LOG.warnf("Event %s (%s) failed schema validation: %s",
                    event.sourceEventId(), event.type().value(), errors);
        }

        entity.createdOn = Instant.now();
        entity.persist();

        LOG.debugf("Persisted event %s: %s [%s]", entity.id, event.type().value(), event.ref());

        persistedEvents.fire(new StreamEventPersisted(
                entity.id.toString(), event.type().value(), event.eventSourceId()));

        return errors.isEmpty() ? PersistOutcome.PERSISTED : PersistOutcome.PERSISTED_INVALID;
    }

    private List<String> validationErrors(NormalizedEvent event) {
        try {
            return schemaRegistry.validate(event);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            return List.of("Schema validation failed: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private String toJson(List<String> errors) {
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(errors);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "[\"" + String.join("; ", errors).replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"]";
        }
    }

package io.apitomy.axiom.events.core;

/** Counts persisted and schema-invalid events during one poll. Not thread-safe; one per poll. */
public class IngestTally {

    private int ingested;
    private int invalid;

    /**
     * Records the outcome of one persist call.
     *
     * @param outcome the outcome
     */
    public void record(PersistOutcome outcome) {
        if (outcome.persisted()) {
            ingested++;
        }
        if (outcome == PersistOutcome.PERSISTED_INVALID) {
            invalid++;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Number of events stored.
     *
     * @return stored count, valid and invalid
     */
    public int ingested() {
        return ingested;
    }

    /**
     * Number of stored events that failed schema validation.
     *
     * @return invalid count
     */
    public int invalid() {
        return invalid;
    }

    /**
     * Suffix for poll-log messages.
     *
     * @return {@code ""} when no event was invalid, else {@code " (N failed schema validation)"}
     */
    public String validationSuffix() {
        return invalid == 0 ? "" : " (" + invalid + " failed schema validation)";
    }
}

    @Inject

    /**

    @Override
    public List<EventSchemaSummary> listEventSchemas() {

docs.title: Event Schema UI Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Drive the Subscription Detail page's EL field reference from the server's event schemas, and show schema validation warnings on the Event Detail page.

Architecture: A pure utility (ui/src/config/eventSchemaPaths.ts) flattens an assembled JSON Schema into {path, type, description, examples} rows. A session-cached hook (ui/src/hooks/useEventSchemas.ts) loads the type list and per-type schemas through new fetch wrappers in ui/src/config/api.ts. A new EventFieldsPanel component renders the rows on the Filter tab, inserts clicked paths into the expression, and feeds the Monaco completion provider, replacing both hard-coded field tables.

Tech Stack: React 19, PatternFly 6 (@patternfly/react-core, @patternfly/react-table), TypeScript, Vite, Vitest 5 + Testing Library (jsdom).

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-21-event-schemas-and-jira-ingestion-design.md (section "Plan 3: UI" and the user-guide bullet of "Documentation"). Plan 1 contract: /tmp/axiom-test/plan1-interfaces.md.

docs.title: Global Constraints
docs.text:
• Plan 1 is merged: GET /api/v1/schemas/events returns EventSchemaSummary[] ({type, description}) sorted by type; GET /api/v1/schemas/events/{eventType} returns a self-contained JSON Schema (only local #/$defs/... refs) or 404; StreamEvent has optional validationErrors: string[].
  • Optional schema fields are {"type": ["string", "null"]} or {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/X"}, {"type": "null"}]}; both collapse to the non-null type in the UI.
  • The UI has no generated TypeScript client. All REST calls are hand-written fetch wrappers in ui/src/config/api.ts using ${API} and extractErrorMessage. Follow that pattern; there is no client regeneration step. (Plan 1's openapi.json change regenerates Java JAX-RS code only.)
  • Paths are prefixed event. (e.g. event.payload.issue.state); arrays appear as [0]; event.sourceData is a single row of type any (source-specific); recursion is bounded.
  • The "Examples" (common expressions) table and the "Operators" table in the filter help modal stay.
  • Code style: 4-space indentation, TSDoc on every exported function/interface, explicit types where not obvious, double quotes.
  • Markdown prose wrapped at 110 characters (tables exempt).
  • All commands run from ui/ unless stated: tests npx vitest run <file>, full suite npm test, typecheck and build npm run build.
  • Commit messages: conventional style (feat(ui): ..., docs: ...), no AI attribution.

docs.title: Task 1: Schema-to-paths utility
docs.text:
Files: - Create: ui/src/config/eventSchemaPaths.ts - Test: ui/src/config/eventSchemaPaths.test.ts

Interfaces: - Consumes: nothing. - Produces: - interface JsonSchema (draft 2020-12 subset, index signature [keyword: string]: unknown) - interface EventFieldRow { path: string; type: string; description: string; examples: unknown[] } - type CompletionNode = { [segment: string]: CompletionNode | string } - const MAX_SCHEMA_DEPTH = 8, const SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE = "any (source-specific)", const PREFERRED_DEFAULT_TYPES = ["issue.opened", "issue.created"] - schemaToPaths(schema: JsonSchema, maxDepth?: number): EventFieldRow[] - typesFromFilterExpression(expression: string, knownTypes: string[]): string[] - defaultEventType(types: string[]): string | undefined - appendPath(expression: string, path: string): string - formatExample(examples: unknown[]): string - pathsToCompletionTree(rows: EventFieldRow[]): CompletionNode

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests

Create ui/src/config/eventSchemaPaths.test.ts:

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
    type EventFieldRow,
    type JsonSchema,
    SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE,
    appendPath,
    defaultEventType,
    formatExample,
    pathsToCompletionTree,
    schemaToPaths,
    typesFromFilterExpression,
} from "./eventSchemaPaths";

/** A trimmed-down assembled schema shaped like Plan 1's output for issue.created. */
const ISSUE_CREATED: JsonSchema = {
    $schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    title: "issue.created",
    description: "An issue was created.",
    type: "object",
    $defs: {
        Actor: {
            type: "object",
            description: "A user account.",
            properties: {
                login: { type: "string", description: "Username or account ID", examples: ["octocat"] },
                displayName: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "Display name" },
            },
        },
        NormalizedIssue: {
            type: "object",
            properties: {
                number: { type: "string", description: "Issue number or key", examples: ["123", "PROJ-1"] },
                state: { type: "string", enum: ["open", "closed"], description: "Normalized state" },
                author: {
                    anyOf: [{ $ref: "#/$defs/Actor" }, { type: "null" }],
                    description: "Issue author",
                },
                assignees: {
                    type: "array",
                    description: "Current assignees",
                    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Actor" },
                },
                labels: { type: "array", description: "Label names", items: { type: "string" } },
            },
        },
    },
    properties: {
        type: { type: "string", const: "issue.created", description: "Normalized event type" },
        actor: { $ref: "#/$defs/Actor", description: "Who triggered the event" },
        payload: {
            type: "object",
            description: "Type-specific payload",
            properties: {
                issue: { $ref: "#/$defs/NormalizedIssue", description: "The issue" },
            },
        },
        sourceData: { description: "Raw source-specific data" },
    },
};

function row(rows: EventFieldRow[], path: string): EventFieldRow | undefined {
    return rows.find((r) => r.path === path);
}

describe("schemaToPaths", () => {
    const rows = schemaToPaths(ISSUE_CREATED);

    it("prefixes every path with event.", () => {
        expect(rows.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(rows.every((r) => r.path.startsWith("event."))).toBe(true);
    });

    it("emits nested payload paths with type, description and examples", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.number")).toEqual({
            path: "event.payload.issue.number",
            type: "string",
            description: "Issue number or key",
            examples: ["123", "PROJ-1"],
        });
    });

    it("uses enum values as examples when none are given", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.state")?.examples).toEqual(["open", "closed"]);
    });

    it("uses const as type and example", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.type")).toMatchObject({ type: "string", examples: ["issue.created"] });
    });

    it("follows local $refs and prefers the property's own description", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.actor")).toMatchObject({ type: "object", description: "Who triggered the event" });
        expect(row(rows, "event.actor.login")?.description).toBe("Username or account ID");
    });

    it("collapses type arrays and anyOf with null to the non-null type", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.actor.displayName")?.type).toBe("string");
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.author")).toMatchObject({ type: "object", description: "Issue author" });
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.author.login")?.type).toBe("string");
    });

    it("shows arrays as [0] and names the item type", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.assignees")?.type).toBe("array<object>");
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.assignees[0].login")?.type).toBe("string");
        expect(row(rows, "event.payload.issue.labels")?.type).toBe("array<string>");
        expect(rows.some((r) => r.path.startsWith("event.payload.issue.labels["))).toBe(false);
    });

    it("shows sourceData as one source-specific row", () => {
        expect(row(rows, "event.sourceData")).toEqual({
            path: "event.sourceData",
            type: SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE,
            description: "Raw source-specific data",
            examples: [],
        });
        expect(rows.filter((r) => r.path.startsWith("event.sourceData"))).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("stops at self-referencing $refs", () => {
        const recursive: JsonSchema = {
            type: "object",
            $defs: {
                Node: {
                    type: "object",
                    properties: {
                        name: { type: "string" },
                        child: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" },
                    },
                },
            },
            properties: { node: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" } },
        };
        expect(schemaToPaths(recursive).map((r) => r.path)).toEqual([
            "event.node",
            "event.node.name",
            "event.node.child",
        ]);
    });

    it("stops at the maximum depth", () => {
        const deep: JsonSchema = {
            type: "object",
            properties: {
                a: { type: "object", properties: { b: { type: "object", properties: { c: { type: "string" } } } } },
            },
        };
        expect(schemaToPaths(deep, 2).map((r) => r.path)).toEqual(["event.a", "event.a.b"]);
    });

    it("reports unresolvable refs as any", () => {
        const broken: JsonSchema = { type: "object", properties: { x: { $ref: "#/$defs/Missing" } } };
        expect(schemaToPaths(broken)).toEqual([{ path: "event.x", type: "any", description: "", examples: [] }]);
    });
});

describe("typesFromFilterExpression", () => {
    const known = ["issue.closed", "issue.created", "pr.merged"];

    it("finds types compared with == in either order and either quote style", () => {
        expect(typesFromFilterExpression(
            "event.type == 'issue.closed' || \"pr.merged\" == event.type", known)).toEqual(["issue.closed", "pr.merged"]);
    });

    it("ignores != comparisons, unknown types and duplicates", () => {
        expect(typesFromFilterExpression(
            "event.type != 'issue.closed' && (event.type == 'nope' || event.type=='pr.merged' || event.type == 'pr.merged')",
            known)).toEqual(["pr.merged"]);
    });

    it("returns an empty list when the expression does not restrict event.type", () => {
        expect(typesFromFilterExpression("event.type.startsWith('issue.')", known)).toEqual([]);
        expect(typesFromFilterExpression("", known)).toEqual([]);
    });
});

describe("defaultEventType", () => {
    it("prefers issue.opened, then issue.created, then the first type", () => {
        expect(defaultEventType(["a", "issue.created", "issue.opened"])).toBe("issue.opened");
        expect(defaultEventType(["a", "issue.created"])).toBe("issue.created");
        expect(defaultEventType(["b", "a"])).toBe("b");
        expect(defaultEventType([])).toBeUndefined();
    });
});

describe("appendPath", () => {
    it("appends with a single space separator", () => {
        expect(appendPath("", "event.type")).toBe("event.type");
        expect(appendPath("a &&", "event.type")).toBe("a && event.type");
        expect(appendPath("a && ", "event.type")).toBe("a && event.type");
    });
});

describe("formatExample", () => {
    it("formats the first example as JSON or a dash", () => {
        expect(formatExample(["open", "closed"])).toBe("\"open\"");
        expect(formatExample([true])).toBe("true");

Create ui/src/config/eventSchemaPaths.ts:

/**
 * Utilities that turn an assembled event JSON Schema (from `GET /schemas/events/{eventType}`) into the flat
 * list of EL paths shown in the subscription filter's Event fields panel and Monaco completion.
 */

/** A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) node; only the keywords the UI reads are typed. */
export interface JsonSchema {
    $ref?: string;
    $defs?: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
    type?: string | string[];
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    examples?: unknown[];
    const?: unknown;
    enum?: unknown[];
    properties?: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
    items?: JsonSchema;
    anyOf?: JsonSchema[];
    oneOf?: JsonSchema[];
    [keyword: string]: unknown;
}

/** One EL-addressable field of an event type. */
export interface EventFieldRow {
    /** EL path, e.g. `event.payload.issue.state`; array elements appear as `[0]`. */
    path: string;
    /** Display type, e.g. `string`, `object`, `array<object>`, `string | number`. */
    type: string;
    /** Description from the schema, or an empty string. */
    description: string;
    /** Example values from `examples`, `const` or `enum`; may be empty. */
    examples: unknown[];
}

/** Nested completion tree: objects are child nodes, leaves are their description text. */
export type CompletionNode = { [segment: string]: CompletionNode | string };

/** Maximum number of path segments below `event` that {@link schemaToPaths} descends. */
export const MAX_SCHEMA_DEPTH = 8;

/** Display type of `event.sourceData`, whose shape depends on the event source. */
export const SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE = "any (source-specific)";

/**
 * Event types preferred as the panel's default selection, in order. The spec names `issue.opened`, but the
 * real `EventType` list uses `issue.created`, so both are listed.
 */
export const PREFERRED_DEFAULT_TYPES: readonly string[] = ["issue.opened", "issue.created"];

const MAX_REF_HOPS = 16;

interface Resolved {
    schema: JsonSchema;
    refs: string[];
    description?: string;
    examples?: unknown[];
}

function resolvePointer(root: JsonSchema, ref: string): JsonSchema | undefined {
    if (!ref.startsWith("#/")) {
        return undefined;
    }
    let node: unknown = root;
    for (const raw of ref.slice(2).split("/")) {
        const key = raw.replace(/~1/g, "/").replace(/~0/g, "~");
        if (node == null || typeof node !== "object") {
            return undefined;
        }
        node = (node as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    }
    return node as JsonSchema | undefined;
}

function isNullSchema(schema: JsonSchema): boolean {
    return schema.type === "null";
}

/**
 * Follows `$ref` chains and collapses `anyOf`/`oneOf` that have exactly one non-null variant. The first
 * description and examples seen (outermost first) win.
 */
function resolve(root: JsonSchema, schema: JsonSchema): Resolved {
    let current: JsonSchema = schema;
    const refs: string[] = [];
    let description: string | undefined = schema.description;
    let examples: unknown[] | undefined = schema.examples;
    for (let hop = 0; hop < MAX_REF_HOPS; hop++) {
        if (current.$ref) {
            if (refs.includes(current.$ref)) {
                break;
            }
            refs.push(current.$ref);
            const target = resolvePointer(root, current.$ref);
            if (!target) {
                break;
            }
            current = target;
        } else {
            const variants = current.anyOf ?? current.oneOf;
            if (!variants) {
                break;
            }
            const nonNull = variants.filter((v) => !isNullSchema(v));
            if (nonNull.length !== 1) {
                break;
            }
            current = nonNull[0];
        }
        description ??= current.description;
        examples ??= current.examples;
    }
    return { schema: current, refs, description, examples };
}

function jsonTypeOf(value: unknown): string {
    if (value === null) {
        return "null";
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return "array";
    }
    return typeof value;
}

function typeName(root: JsonSchema, schema: JsonSchema): string {
    if (schema.$ref) {
        return "any";
    }
    if (schema.const !== undefined) {
        return jsonTypeOf(schema.const);
    }
    const declared: string[] = Array.isArray(schema.type)
        ? schema.type.filter((t) => t !== "null")
        : schema.type ? [schema.type] : [];
    if (declared.includes("array") || (declared.length === 0 && schema.items)) {
        const items = schema.items ? resolve(root, schema.items).schema : undefined;
        return `array<${items ? typeName(root, items) : "any"}>`;
    }
    if (declared.length > 0) {
        return declared.join(" | ");
    }
    if (schema.properties) {
        return "object";
    }
    if (schema.enum && schema.enum.length > 0) {
        return jsonTypeOf(schema.enum[0]);
    }
    const variants = schema.anyOf ?? schema.oneOf;
    if (variants) {
        const names = variants.filter((v) => !isNullSchema(v)).map((v) => typeName(root, resolve(root, v).schema));
        return [...new Set(names)].join(" | ") || "any";
    }
    return "any";
}

function examplesOf(resolved: Resolved): unknown[] {
    if (resolved.examples) {
        return resolved.examples;
    }
    if (resolved.schema.const !== undefined) {
        return [resolved.schema.const];
    }
    return resolved.schema.enum ?? [];
}

function walk(root: JsonSchema, node: JsonSchema, prefix: string, depth: number, refStack: string[],
    maxDepth: number, rows: EventFieldRow[]): void {
    for (const [name, propSchema] of Object.entries(node.properties ?? {})) {
        const path = `${prefix}.${name}`;
        if (path === "event.sourceData") {
            rows.push({ path, type: SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE, description: propSchema.description ?? "", examples: [] });
            continue;
        }
        const resolved = resolve(root, propSchema);
        rows.push({
            path,
            type: typeName(root, resolved.schema),
            description: resolved.description ?? "",
            examples: examplesOf(resolved),
        });
        if (depth + 1 >= maxDepth || resolved.refs.some((r) => refStack.includes(r))) {
            continue;
        }
        const stack = [...refStack, ...resolved.refs];
        if (resolved.schema.properties) {
            walk(root, resolved.schema, path, depth + 1, stack, maxDepth, rows);
        } else if (resolved.schema.items) {
            const item = resolve(root, resolved.schema.items);
            if (item.schema.properties && !item.refs.some((r) => stack.includes(r))) {
                walk(root, item.schema, `${path}[0]`, depth + 1, [...stack, ...item.refs], maxDepth, rows);
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Flattens an assembled event schema into EL field rows.
 *
 * Follows local `$ref`s, collapses nullable types to the non-null type, shows array elements as `[0]`,
 * reports `event.sourceData` as a single {@link SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TYPE} row, and never descends into a `$ref`
 * that is already being expanded or past `maxDepth` segments.
 *
 * @param schema the assembled schema for one event type
 * @param maxDepth maximum number of path segments below `event`
 * @returns rows in schema declaration order, parents before children
 */
export function schemaToPaths(schema: JsonSchema, maxDepth: number = MAX_SCHEMA_DEPTH): EventFieldRow[] {
    const rows: EventFieldRow[] = [];
    walk(schema, schema, "event", 0, [], maxDepth, rows);
    return rows;
}

/**
 * Finds the event types a filter expression compares `event.type` to with `==`.
 *
 * @param expression the EL filter expression
 * @param knownTypes the event types the server knows; others are ignored
 * @returns matching known types, in order of first appearance, without duplicates
 */
export function typesFromFilterExpression(expression: string, knownTypes: string[]): string[] {
    const found: string[] = [];
    const pattern = /event\.type\s*==\s*(['"])([^'"]+)\1|(['"])([^'"]+)\3\s*==\s*event\.type/g;
    for (const match of expression.matchAll(pattern)) {
        const type = match[2] ?? match[4];
        if (knownTypes.includes(type) && !found.includes(type)) {
            found.push(type);
        }
    }
    return found;
}

/**
 * Chooses the default event type for the Event fields panel.
 *
 * @param types the selectable types
 * @returns the first of {@link PREFERRED_DEFAULT_TYPES} present, else the first type, else undefined
 */
export function defaultEventType(types: string[]): string | undefined {
    return PREFERRED_DEFAULT_TYPES.find((t) => types.includes(t)) ?? types[0];
}

/**
 * Appends a field path to an expression, separated by one space when the expression is non-empty.
 *
 * @param expression the current expression
 * @param path the path to append
 * @returns the new expression
 */
export function appendPath(expression: string, path: string): string {
    const separator = expression && !expression.endsWith(" ") ? " " : "";
    return expression + separator + path;
}

/**
 * Formats the first example for display.
 *
 * @param examples example values
 * @returns the first example as JSON, or an em dash when there is none
 */
export function formatExample(examples: unknown[]): string {
    return examples.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(examples[0]) : "—";
}

/**
 * Builds the Monaco completion tree from field rows. Rows containing `[0]` are skipped because EL completion
 * works on dotted identifiers only; the array row itself remains as a leaf.
 *
 * @param rows rows from {@link schemaToPaths}
 * @returns the tree rooted at `event`
 */
export function pathsToCompletionTree(rows: EventFieldRow[]): CompletionNode {
    const root: CompletionNode = {};
    for (const row of rows) {
        if (row.path.includes("[")) {
            continue;
        }
        const segments = row.path.split(".");
        let node: CompletionNode = root;
        segments.forEach((segment, index) => {
            const existing = node[segment];
            if (index === segments.length - 1) {
                if (existing === undefined) {
                    node[segment] = row.description || row.type;
                }
                return;
            }
            if (typeof existing !== "object") {
                node[segment] = {};
            }
            node = node[segment] as CompletionNode;
        });
    }
    return root;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { type EventSchemaSummary, fetchEventSchema, fetchEventSchemas } from "../config/api";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../config/eventSchemaPaths";

/** Loading state of a cached request. */
export interface AsyncState<T> {
    data: T | undefined;
    loading: boolean;
    error: string | undefined;
}

let listPromise: Promise<EventSchemaSummary[]> | undefined;
const schemaPromises = new Map<string, Promise<JsonSchema>>();

/** Clears the session cache. Intended for tests. */
export function clearEventSchemaCache(): void {
    listPromise = undefined;
    schemaPromises.clear();
}

function cachedList(): Promise<EventSchemaSummary[]> {
    if (!listPromise) {
        listPromise = fetchEventSchemas().catch((e: unknown) => {
            listPromise = undefined;
            throw e;
        });
    }
    return listPromise;
}

function cachedSchema(eventType: string): Promise<JsonSchema> {
    let promise = schemaPromises.get(eventType);
    if (!promise) {
        promise = fetchEventSchema(eventType).catch((e: unknown) => {
            schemaPromises.delete(eventType);
            throw e;
        });
        schemaPromises.set(eventType, promise);
    }
    return promise;
}

function useCached<T>(key: string | undefined, load: (key: string) => Promise<T>): AsyncState<T> {
    const [state, setState] = useState<AsyncState<T>>(
        { data: undefined, loading: key !== undefined, error: undefined });
    useEffect(() => {
        if (key === undefined) {
            setState({ data: undefined, loading: false, error: undefined });
            return;
        }
        let cancelled = false;
        setState((prev) => ({ data: prev.data, loading: true, error: undefined }));
        load(key)
            .then((data) => {
                if (!cancelled) setState({ data, loading: false, error: undefined });
            })
            .catch((e: unknown) => {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setState({ data: undefined, loading: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
                }
            });
        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [key]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    return state;
}

/**
 * Loads the list of event types with schemas, cached for the browser session.
 *
 * @returns the loading state of the list
 */
export function useEventSchemas(): AsyncState<EventSchemaSummary[]> {
    return useCached("list", () => cachedList());
}

/**
 * Loads the assembled schema for one event type, cached per type for the browser session.
 *
 * @param eventType the event type, or undefined to load nothing
 * @returns the loading state of the schema
 */
export function useEventSchema(eventType: string | undefined): AsyncState<JsonSchema> {
    return useCached(eventType, cachedSchema);
}

    formatExample,
    schemaToPaths,
    typesFromFilterExpression,
} from "../config/eventSchemaPaths";
import { useEventSchema, useEventSchemas } from "../hooks/useEventSchemas";

/** Props of {@link EventFieldsPanel}. */
export interface EventFieldsPanelProps {
    /** Current filter expression; `event.type == '...'` comparisons restrict the type picker. */
    filterExpression: string;
    /** Called with a field path when the user clicks it. */
    onSelectPath: (path: string) => void;
    /** Called whenever the rows for the selected type change (used to feed editor completion). */
    onRowsChange?: (rows: EventFieldRow[]) => void;
}

/**
 * Schema-driven reference of the EL fields available for an event type. Shows the types named in the filter
 * expression, or every type when the expression names none.
 *
 * @param props the panel props
 * @returns the panel
 */
export function EventFieldsPanel({ filterExpression, onSelectPath, onRowsChange }: EventFieldsPanelProps) {
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<boolean>(true);
    const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
    const list = useEventSchemas();

    const allTypes: string[] = useMemo(() => (list.data ?? []).map((s) => s.type), [list.data]);
    const filterTypes: string[] = useMemo(
        () => typesFromFilterExpression(filterExpression, allTypes), [filterExpression, allTypes]);
    const choices: string[] = filterTypes.length > 0 ? filterTypes : allTypes;
    const selected: string | undefined = picked && choices.includes(picked) ? picked : defaultEventType(choices);

    const schema = useEventSchema(selected);
    const rows: EventFieldRow[] = useMemo(() => (schema.data ? schemaToPaths(schema.data) : []), [schema.data]);

    useEffect(() => {
        onRowsChange?.(rows);
    }, [rows, onRowsChange]);

    return (
        <ExpandableSection toggleText="Event fields" isExpanded={expanded}
            onToggle={(_e, value) => setExpanded(value)} style={{ marginTop: "16px" }}>
            {list.error ? (
                <Alert variant="warning" isInline title="Event field reference is unavailable">
                    {list.error}
                </Alert>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <FormGroup label="Event type" fieldId="event-fields-type" style={{ maxWidth: "400px" }}>
                        <FormSelect id="event-fields-type" aria-label="Event type" value={selected ?? ""}
                            onChange={(_e, value) => setPicked(value)} isDisabled={choices.length === 0}>
                            {choices.map((t) => <FormSelectOption key={t} value={t} label={t} />)}
                        </FormSelect>
                        <HelperText>
                            <HelperTextItem>
                                {filterTypes.length > 0
                                    ? "Showing the event types used in your filter expression."
                                    : "Your filter expression does not restrict event.type; pick a type to see its fields."}
                            </HelperTextItem>
                        </HelperText>
                    </FormGroup>
                    {schema.data?.description && (
                        <p style={{ marginTop: "8px" }}>{schema.data.description}</p>
                    )}
                    {schema.error && (
                        <Alert variant="warning" isInline title="Could not load the schema" style={{ marginTop: "8px" }}>
                            {schema.error}
                        </Alert>
                    )}
                    <div style={{ maxHeight: "320px", overflowY: "auto", marginTop: "8px" }}>
                        <Table aria-label="Event fields" variant="compact" isStickyHeader>
                            <Thead>
                                <Tr>
                                    <Th>Path</Th>
                                    <Th>Type</Th>
                                    <Th>Description</Th>
                                    <Th>Example</Th>
                                </Tr>
                            </Thead>
                            <Tbody>
                                {rows.map((row) => (
                                    <Tr key={row.path}>
                                        <Td>
                                            <Button variant="link" isInline aria-label={`Insert ${row.path}`}
                                                onClick={() => onSelectPath(row.path)}>
                                                <code>{row.path}</code>
                                            </Button>
                                        </Td>
                                        <Td>{row.type}</Td>
                                        <Td>{row.description}</Td>
                                        <Td><code>{formatExample(row.examples)}</code></Td>
                                    </Tr>
                                ))}
                            </Tbody>
                        </Table>
                    </div>
                </>
            )}
        </ExpandableSection>
    );
}
